title: Tech Lead
description:
**Var Carla Står**
 Vi tycker att fler borde kunna köra elbil. Därför bygger vi det tryggaste, enklaste och mest transparenta sättet att köpa och sälja begagnade bilar — hela vägen, från att vi köper in bilen till att den står på kundens uppfart.
   

  

 Vi är en av de fem största handlarna av begagnade bilar i Sverige, och vi tar marknadsandelar snabbt. Vi startade 2020 i Stockholm, är drygt 250 personer och har Verdane och Bonnier Ventures bland ägarna.
   

  

**Problemet Du Får**
 Att köpa bil på nätet ska kännas lika självklart som allt annat man köper på nätet. Att få det att faktiskt fungera är något helt annat: kunden ska våga lita på en bil hen aldrig sett, bilen ska finansieras, levereras hem och supportas efteråt, och ingenting får tappas bort på vägen.
   

  

 Samtidigt är marginalen på affären avgjord långt innan kunden dyker upp. Allt hänger på hur väl vi förstår bilens skick — och det gör vi i flera steg: vad kunden själv uppger, vad inköparen bedömer, vad inspektionen på plats visar, och vilka avdrag det landar i. Varje steg ska fånga det som det förra missade, och varje felbedömning syns direkt i marginalen. Systemen du ansvarar för är det som håller ihop affären end-to-end.
   

  

 Nästan alla system vi kör bygger vi själva. Affären är för unik för att något färdigköpt ska passa: inköp, värdering, verkstad, logistik, finansiering och försäljning hänger ihop i en och samma kedja, och den kedjan finns inte att köpa.
   

  

 I mitten står vårt BackOffice — systemet som i stort sett alla avdelningar arbetar i, kommersiella som operativa, och som håller ihop bilen och affären genom hela livscykeln. Mycket av din tid kommer att ligga där. Det är i ett bra skick för ett bolag i vår ålder, och uppgiften är inte att städa upp utan vidareutveckla med fortsatt hög kvalitet medan volymen växer.
   

  

**Vad Du Gör**
 Du leder det tekniska arbetet bakom alla våra kommersiella systemstöd — från hur vi värderar och köper in bilar till hur de säljs, levereras och supporteras. Det gäller både de digitala touchpointsen mot kund och de interna processerna, som är minst lika viktiga.
   

  

 Du rapporterar till Peter Simon, vår CPTO. Vi är ett tiotal utvecklare plus produkt och design i två tvärfunktionella produktteam. Du som Tech Lead för Commercial, tillsammans med din motsvarighet i Operations, sätter riktningen för plattformen framåt.
   

  

**Jobbet, i Timmar**
*Ungefär så här ser veckan ut:*
* 30–50 % skriver du kod själv
* 20–30 % discovery — förstå vad verksamheten faktiskt behöver, och bryta ner det i tekniska delar tillsammans med din Product Manager, Designer och såklart utvecklare
* ~10 % är du chef för fyra utvecklare, backend och frontend
* Resten är bruset som följer med att vara den som vet hur allt hänger ihop


**Vad Vi Bygger i**
 Go i backend på Encore, TypeScript i frontend, allt på GCP. BigQuery och Looker Studio för data. Som ett modernt bolag så deployar vi såklart varje dag.
   

  

 AI-assisterad utveckling använder vi på riktigt, inte dekorativt. Vi kör Claude, Cursor och Codex parallellt för att hitta den setup som fungerar bäst för oss. Vi har inte landat än, och du kommer att vara med och avgöra var det makes sense att vi arbetar likadant vs var det är ok att vi gör olika.
   

  

**Vad Vi Letar Efter**
* Du har lett utvecklare och vill fortfarande vara nära koden. Du bryr dig om att det som går i produktion håller kvalitet, men är mindre brydd om vem (eller vad) som skrev det.
* Du är stark i Go och TypeScript, och uppskattar möjligheten att få jobba full-stack.
* Du är bekväm med att bygga och underhålla integrationer mot tredjepartssystem.
* Du använder AI-verktyg dagligen och har omdöme om var de hjälper och var de tyst kostar dig.
* Du bygger hellre något som flyttar en siffra det här kvartalet än den perfekta plattformen.


**Praktiskt**
* Stockholm, Vasastan. Vi ses på kontoret ca tre till fyra dagar i veckan (eller fem om du vill!). Det är medvetet för just den här rollen — discovery görs med sälj, inköp och support, och vi tror att mötas med produktägare och designer regelbundet är bra för samarbete, motivation och resultat.
* Vi kodar, dokumenterar och granskar på engelska, och ett par av utvecklarna i ditt team sitter utomlands. Svenskan behöver du för att verksamheten runt dig jobbar på svenska, och den här rollen sitter nära den.


**Nästa Steg**
 Du behöver inget CV för att prata med oss. Första samtalet är trettio minuter med vår rekryterare Sandra Palm. Direkt efter det träffar du Peter Simon, vår CPTO, som kan berätta vad som faktiskt är svårt i jobbet och svara på vad du vill fråga.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Why this role exists**
 We build Radio Units (RUs) that work as high-speed, secure, jam-resistant data pipelines for defence and dual-use applications — the connective tissue for UAV C2, deployable 5G, and tactical awareness systems.
   

  

 Our pipeline is full of customers — defence primes, armed forces, industrial operators — who are excited about what our RU could do for them.
 **The bottleneck isn't interest. It's that we don't have enough hands to sit with those customers, understand their actual problem, build something that proves it, and spot the patterns before anyone else does so we can feed them into our product roadmap.** 
 That's the job. You'll be the person who turns "this is interesting, let's talk again" into "we've seen it work, here's a contract."
   

  

**What You'll Actually Do**
* Sit in rooms with customers — sometimes a defence prime's systems architect, sometimes a signals officer, sometimes both — and figure out what they actually need (which is rarely what they first asked for).
* Scope and build PoCs and demos that integrate our RU with whatever the customer cares about: cameras, radars, microphones, ground stations on one end; data lakes, AI tooling, C2 software on the other.
* Do the integration work end-to-end. That means wiring a physical kit on Monday, debugging a MAVLink message on Tuesday, writing Python to push sensor data into a customer's stack on Wednesday, and demoing the whole thing on Thursday.
* Travel to customer sites in the US and across Europe. Sometimes you'll deploy and run a demo in the field. Sometimes you'll spend a week embedded with a prime's engineering team.
* Feed what you learn back into product. The patterns you find — the integrations customers keep asking for, the operational constraints that keep showing up — are how we figure out what to build next.
* Work directly with our CEO on the highest-priority opportunities. Until our CCO is in seat, you'll be operating with a lot of autonomy and short feedback loops.


**What We're Looking For**
**This is a hybrid role — equally happy soldering a cable and writing the Python that ingests what comes out of it. We don't expect you to have done all of the below, but you should be credibly strong on most of it:**
* Full-stack engineering instincts. You've built things end-to-end and you don't wait for someone else to define the interface.
* Hardware comfort. RF, comms, sensors, embedded systems — you've been around it. You're not scared of an oscilloscope or a radio link budget.
* Software fluency. Python is table stakes. You've worked with data pipelines, APIs, and at least one of the things our customers care about: drone autopilots (MAVLink, STANAG 4586), sensor fusion, edge processing, AI/ML inference at the edge, ground control stations.
* Customer-facing presence. You can sit in front of a colonel, a procurement officer, or a prime's chief engineer and earn their trust. You don't need a script.
* A bias for shipping. You've built demos and prototypes under time pressure. You know the difference between "demo-good" and "production-good" and you make the right call for the situation.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Customer says something vague. You don't wait for it to get clearer — you go figure out what they actually mean.


 We're open on seniority. If you're 4 years in and exceptional, we want to talk. If you're 10 years in and want to be hands-on at a stage where what you build defines the company, we want to talk.
   

  

**Background that fits**
**This Is Illustrative, Not a Checklist**
* Integration engineers from drone, robotics, or autonomy companies (typically Payload Integration, Flight Software, Ground Systems, or Integration Engineers at Auterion, Tekever, Quantum Systems, and similar) who've done real customer integration work.
* Forward Deployed / Mission Engineers from neo-defence companies (typically FDEs or FDSEs at Palantir; Mission Operations, Mission Software, or Mission Deployment Engineers at Anduril; and equivalent customer-facing engineers at Shield AI, Tekever, or similar).
* Engineers from RF, comms, or satellite companies (typically Firmware, Baseband, RF Systems, or Systems Integration Engineers at Bittium, Sivers Semiconductors, Gapwaves, Ericsson, Mynaric, or comms divisions at Saab, Leonardo, L3Harris, and Thales).
* Ex-military signals, EW, or comms officers (Signals Officers, Communications Officers, Electronic Warfare Officers, or Combat Systems Engineers) who've moved into engineering roles and miss being close to operators.
* Engineers from defence primes' rapid prototyping or skunkworks teams (typically Capability, Systems, Prototyping, or Applied Research Engineers) who are tired of the pace.


**What We're Not Looking For**
* Solutions Engineers from SaaS who are used to a defined demo script and a clean handoff to a CSM.
* Pure researchers or lab engineers who haven't shipped to real users.
* Career salespeople with a technical veneer.
* People who need a fully scoped backlog before they can start.


**What You'll Get**
* A seat at the table while we build the commercial function from scratch. The PoCs you build will define our product roadmap and our first multi-million-euro contracts.
* Direct working relationship with the CEO and the rest of the founding team.
* Real customers from week one. We have live opportunities in UAV C2 and deployable 5G that need an FDE on them today.
* Equity that reflects the impact. You'll be one of the first commercial hires.
* Salary commensurate with experience — we'll calibrate to your level and the market.


 TERASi is a deeptech startup based in Stockholm, Sweden which offers unique components and packaging for high-frequency wireless applications.
   

  

 TERASi’s technology builds upon academic research at KTH Royal Institute of Technology and years of internal R&D. The company designs and manufactures all components from its Stockholm headquarters and now embarks upon a mission to scale their technology and bring it to mass markets.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Motiveras du av att arbeta med moderna teknologier och lösa problem för kunder inom olika branscher kan DU vara vår nästa Data Engineer!
 



  





 Våra närmare
 **100 dataexperter** 
 i Sverige jobbar med datalösningar inom nästan alla teknologier. Ett vanligt projekt varierar i längd från en månad till några år, och situationen kan justeras baserat på dina önskemål.
 



  





**Hur är det att jobba på Solita?** 




 Oavsett kund, projekt eller bransch har du hos oss alltid tillgång till ett stort nätverk av fantastiskt kunniga, passionerade datakollegor, som bara är ett slackmeddelande bort. Därtill kan du ständigt lära dig nytt genom våra autonoma competence communities, infosessions och möjligheten att ta olika certifikationer etc.
 



  





 Vill du utvecklas och ligga i framkant inom datalösningar, så har vi rätt mycket att komma med! Solitas företagskultur handlar om autonomi, att stötta och växa tillsammans med våra kollegor samt att leva våra värdeord – passion, courage, easy-going och caring. Utöver detta har vi även
 **partnerskap** 
 med en mängd tech-företag såsom
 **, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks** 
 för att nämna några.
 



  





**Träffa en Solitan** 




 Möt
 **Clara Lundström,** 
 en Data Engineer här på Solita. Hon arbetar i ett projekt för ett globalt företag inom facility service, det största i Norden. Clara, tillsammans med ett team av Solita-entusiaster, belyser datalandskapet och använder data från olika källor för att skapa visualiseringar. Erfaren med molnverktyg arbetar hon med data, automation och transformation.
 



  





*“Att arbeta som konsult på Solita är varierat samtidigt som du har tillgång till ett stort nätverk av experter inom många olika områden. Det ger utmärkta möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll, vare sig det handlar om att bredda dina kunskaper eller specialisera dig. Anledningen till att jag trivs så bra på Solita är den vänliga, stödjande och opretentiösa atmosfären.”* 




  





**Vem är du?** 




 Som
 **Data Engineer på Solita** 
 är du med och bygger datadrivna lösningar som gör skillnad för våra kunder. Du arbetar med pipelines, plattformar och datalager, samtidigt som du kommunicerar med kunder och kollegor för att skapa hållbara och användbara lösningar.
 



  





**Dina ansvarsområden:** 



* Utveckla, testa och underhålla datapipelines
* Lösa tekniska utmaningar och bidra med expertis
* Förstå kundernas behov och omsätta dem i användbara datatillgångar
* Samarbeta med analytiker och utvecklare för att skapa affärskritiska lösningar
* Bidra till att skapa återanvändbara dataset och modeller
* Planera och driva ditt arbete självständigt



  





**Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av:** 



* Data pipelines, datamodellering och datalager
* SQL och/eller Python i molnmiljöer
* Har jobbat med verktyg som Snowflake, dbt, Databricks, MS Fabric, Data Factory och BigQuery
* Flytande svenska och engelska



  





 Vill du veta mer om hur det är att jobba som Data Engineer kan du läsa vår kollega Lisa Khylbergs People Story här!
 **https://www.solita.fi/blogs/people-of-solita-lisa-kyhlberg-senior-data-engineer/** 




  





**Vår kundmålgrupp** 




 Vi riktar oss mot företag och organisationer inom alla branscher som vill utnyttja kraften i data för att förbättra sina affärsprocesser och fatta bättre beslut. Våra kunder finns inom bland annat inom produktutveckling, hälsa, industri, försäkring, kommunikation, bank och elförsörjning. Vi arbetar med både stora och små företag som har behov av avancerade datalösningar och analys.
 



  





**Vad vi erbjuder** 




 Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter en kultur som betonar en låg hierarki, hög entusiasm, värdeorienterat arbete och kollegor som är lättsamma och passionerade och alltid finns där för att hjälpa till. Det betyder att du är avgörande i att leda din utveckling och ditt arbete med ett brett kollegialt nätverk som du alltid kan vända dig till – i både vått och torrt!
 **Här** 
 kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och
 **här** 
 kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.
 


* **Meningsfulla projekt:** 
 Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
* **Flexibilitet och autonomi** 
 för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår
 **blogg.**
* **Ständig utveckling:** 
 Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
* **Innovativ kultur:** 
 Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling



  





 Utöver detta får du även ta del av
 **förmåner** 
 så som
 **;** 
 fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande,
 **sjukvårdsförsäkring** 
 via Skandia,
 **friskvårdsbidrag** 
 på 5000 kr, after works, hobby aktiviteter och
 **fredagsfrukost** 
 för att nämna några!
 



**Intresserad?** 




  





 Vid frågor; kontakta maja.oderstedt(at)solita.se, eller jacob.beck(at)solita.se alternativt ansök här. Vi är intresserade av att höra mer om din motivation och hur du ser din tillväxt framför dig. Dela ditt CV nedan så återkommer vi så fort vi kan!
 



  





**Hur ser processen ut?** 




 I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en gedigen och effektiv process. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning, bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

title: Det här är inte en traditionell TSA‑roll Inte heller en ren utvecklarroll
description:
Det här är inte en traditionell TSA‑roll. Och det är inte heller en ren utvecklarroll.
   

  

 Det är för dig som vill kombinera stabil förvaltning med utveckling framåt och samtidigt vara med och forma hur D365, AI och Microsofts plattform faktiskt används hos våra kunder.
   

  

 Hos Nexer Enterprise Applications arbetar vi både nära befintliga lösningar och i framkant av ny teknik. Här får du en roll där du både förvaltar, förbättrar och utvecklar med stort inflytande över hur arbetet sker.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Du kliver in i vårt Dynamics Tech-team med ansvar för den tekniska helheten inom Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management.
   

  

**Det innebär att du** 
 :
   

  

* Säkerställer stabil drift och vidareutveckling i befintliga lösningar.
* Agerar tekniskt stöd och rådgivare till kunder och team.
* Driver förbättringar inom arkitektur, integrationer och prestanda.
* Är med och sätter riktning för hur vi arbetar med ny teknik exempelvis AI, Copilot och Power Platform.


 Du rör dig mellan det operativa och det strategiska.
   

  

 I ena stunden felsöker eller optimerar du befintliga lösningar och i nästa diskuterar du hur AI eller automation kan skapa nya värden framåt.
   

  

**Så jobbar vi:**
 Vi tror på långsiktiga relationer både med kunder och kollegor.
   

  

**Det betyder:**
* Förvaltning (care) är lika viktigt som projekt.
* Du får tid att förstå kundens verksamhet på riktigt.
* Vi arbetar nära både teknik och affär utan onödiga lager.
* Du har mandat att påverka lösningar, arbetssätt och tekniska vägval.


**Samtidigt vill vi utvecklas.**
 Vi utforskar aktivt hur AI, Copilot och nya plattformsfunktioner kan användas i vardagen inte för att det är nytt, utan för att det skapar verkligt värde.
   

  

 Vem är du?
   

  

 Du har en trygg teknisk bas inom D365 F&SCM, kanske som utvecklare eller TSA, och trivs i en roll där du får ta ansvar över tid.
   

  

**På samma gång är du nyfiken framåt.**
**Du har:**
* Erfarenhet av D365 F&SCM (F&O) och gärna Dynamics AX.
* Har arbetat med utveckling, integrationer och teknisk arkitektur.
* Är van att arbeta nära kund och förstår verksamhetens behov.
* Gillar att förbättra, förenkla och hitta smartare lösningar.
* Är nyfiken på AI, Copilot eller Power Platform och vill förstå hur det faktiskt kan användas.


**Du behöver inte vara längst fram i allt nytt men du har ett intresse av att utforska och utvecklas.**
**Hos oss får du:**
* Möjlighet att påverka tekniska beslut och arbetssätt.
* Kombinationen av trygg leverans och framtidsfokus.
* Kollegor med hög kompetens och en kultur där vi delar kunskap.
* Tillgång till Nexers globala nätverk och nära samarbete med Microsoft.


**Life at Nexer.**
 Vi är ett team med stark gemenskap, hög kompetens och nära ledarskap.
   

  

 Här finns både tryggheten i etablerade kundrelationer och möjligheten att utvecklas inom nya områden.
   

  

 Vi arbetar nationellt och globalt, men alltid nära varandra i vardagen.
   

  

 Här kan du läsa mer om oss: https://nexergroup.com/careerhub/come-on-in-nexer-ea/

 : Hybrid, Sverige.
   

  

**Omfattning**

 Det här är rollen för dig som vill ha mer än bara drift, men inte heller jaga nästa trend för sakens skull. Du vill förstå, förbättra och samtidigt bygga framåt.

title: Microsoft Security Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by seven Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Rome, Johannesburg and Cape Town.
   

  

 With over 780 employees, including more than 585 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.
   

  

 At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Job Role / Responsibilities
   

  

 As a Microsoft Security Engineer, you will be responsible for onboarding clients to our managed security service, with Microsoft Sentinel at the centre of the solution. You will configure and integrate Sentinel environments, onboard and validate log sources, and prepare each deployment for effective monitoring and operational handover to the Security Operations Centre.
   

  

 Your primary focus will be the technical delivery of new Microsoft Sentinel onboardings. This includes workspace and connector configuration, data collection design, log-source integration, ingestion filtering, validation, detection tuning and the production of high-level design and implementation documentation. You will work closely with clients, architects and SOC teams to ensure each deployment is supportable, secure and aligned with the contracted service scope.
   

  

 The role also requires hands-on experience, or a clear ability to develop quickly, in onboarding Microsoft Defender XDR workloads such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps. You will help establish the integrations, policies and operational workflows required to provide joined-up detection and response across the Microsoft security ecosystem.
   

  

 This is a client-facing engineering role within Professional Services, reporting to the Head of Cloud Security & Microsoft Security Services. You will manage assigned onboarding activities from discovery and design through implementation, testing, documentation and handover. You will be supported by an experienced team and have access to training and certification opportunities across Microsoft security technologies.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Deliver end-to-end onboarding of client Microsoft Sentinel environments into the MSSP service.
* Configure Sentinel workspaces, content solutions, data connectors, analytics rules, automation rules, watchlists, workbooks and related components in accordance with approved designs and service standards.
* Run technical discovery sessions to identify log sources, connectivity requirements, data volumes, retention needs, dependencies and onboarding priorities.
* Onboard Microsoft, third-party, cloud, network, identity and application log sources using supported collection methods, including Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, APIs, syslog, CEF and custom connectors where appropriate.
* Design and implement data filtering and transformation to improve signal quality, control ingestion costs and ensure the service receives the telemetry required for monitoring and detection.
* Validate data ingestion, parsing, field mapping, timestamps, health and coverage, and troubleshoot issues across source systems, collectors, networks and Azure services.
* Tune analytics rules, alert logic and incident generation in collaboration with SOC and detection engineering teams to reduce unnecessary noise while maintaining appropriate coverage.
* Onboard and integrate Microsoft Defender XDR workloads, including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
* Produce accurate high-level designs, implementation plans, configuration records, test evidence, operational runbooks and handover documentation.
* Coordinate with clients, project managers, architects, SOC analysts and service teams to manage dependencies, risks, actions and readiness for service transition.
* Apply repeatable engineering standards, peer review and change control, and contribute improvements to onboarding templates, technical patterns and internal procedures.
* Support troubleshooting and remediation during onboarding and early-life support, escalating product or service dependencies where required.
* Undertake occasional travel where required to support client delivery.


**Essential**
* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring or supporting Microsoft Sentinel in production or customer environments.
* Practical knowledge of Sentinel data connectors, Log Analytics workspaces, Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, syslog and CEF collection patterns.
* Strong Kusto Query Language skills for data validation, troubleshooting, investigation and detection tuning.
* Experience onboarding and troubleshooting log sources across Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoints, identity, network, security and third-party platforms.
* Understanding of ingestion filtering, data transformation, parsing, normalisation, retention and the cost implications of security telemetry.
* Experience creating clear technical designs and delivery documentation, including HLDs, implementation plans, test records and operational handover materials.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender XDR and the integration of its workloads with Microsoft Sentinel.
* Sound understanding of SIEM operations, detection engineering principles, incident workflows and the requirements of a managed security service.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Azure, APIs, identity, networking and data collection components.
* Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with technical and non-technical client stakeholders.
* Ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating effectively with project, architecture, SOC and service teams.


 Desired
   

  

* Experience working for an MSSP, MDR provider, Security Operations Centre or security-focused professional services team.
* Development of custom log parsers, KQL functions, ASIM-compatible content or other normalisation patterns for non-standard data sources.
* Experience with DevOps pipelines and source control for Microsoft Sentinel content, configuration and deployment.
* Practical knowledge of detection as code, including versioning, testing, peer review and controlled promotion of analytics content between environments.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and automation using technologies such as Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Logic Apps or APIs.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel repositories, content management and repeatable multi-customer deployment patterns.
* Experience integrating Microsoft security services across tenants, subscriptions or delegated administration models such as Azure Lighthouse.
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and its application to detection coverage and use-case mapping.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200).
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500/SC-500).
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100).
* Relevant Microsoft Applied Skills covering Sentinel, Defender XDR, security operations or automation.
* Other relevant security or cloud certifications are beneficial but not essential.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Playground Data
   

  

* Stockholm
* Hybrid


 Senior Data Scientist
   

  

 We usually respond within a week
   

  

 Some data problems are neat and tidy. Ours usually aren't. They are messy, evolving, and tied to real decisions. We work closely with our clients to understand what actually needs to be solved and build from there.
   

  

 At Playground, we help clients put their data to work, from the platforms underneath to the models and AI solutions on top. We are a collaborative team that values solid engineering and shared growth, and our people see their work through, from first idea to production.
   

  

 What you'll actually do
   

  

 You'll work closely with our clients on initiatives where data science has a direct impact on how they operate. This role suits a data scientist who wants to work full-stack and own things end to end: making sense of messy data, deciding what's worth solving, building the models and seeing it through to production. Many of our engagements start from scratch, so you'll often be shaping the solution from day one.
   

  

**In Practice, You’ll**
* Connect data from disparate sources and dig into it to find anomalies, inconsistencies and quality issues.
* Set up rule engines and validation logic that encode business rules and catch problems automatically.
* Model complex domains into semantic models that capture how a client's organization actually works.
* Build and train models, picking the right method for the problem.
* Take your work all the way to production and keep improving it over time.
* Contribute internally by mentoring colleagues, shaping how we work with data science, being part of presales and supporting Playground's continued growth.


 You’ll never sit idle, there’s always something meaningful to build, improve, or untangle.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 You've worked as a data scientist for several years and have delivered data solutions, analyses and models that people rely on. Python and SQL are part of your daily toolkit, and you've worked with at least one cloud or data platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake etc.).
   

  

**You Would Probably Describe Yourself As Someone Who**
* Owns it end to end: You'd rather shape the problem yourself and take it all the way to production than wait for a ticket or hand it over halfway.
* Has solid fundamentals: You know your statistics and data modeling well enough to pick the right method, and explain why.
* Has an eye for data quality: Inconsistencies bug you, and you dig until you understand where they come from and how to stop them.
* Is comfortable in a consultant role: You handle customer dialogue well, can contribute in presales, and help guide clients through difficult decisions.


 As a person, you’re humble, genuinely curious about technology, and motivated, while knowing that asking for help is a strength, not a weakness. Friendly, curious, and playful.
   

  

 You must be based in the Stockholm area and have a valid work permit for Sweden (no visa sponsorship or relocation).
   

  

 Buzzword bingo: Python, SQL, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Data Modeling, Semantic Models, Rule Engines
   

  

 Language requirement
   

  

 You need to be fluent in Swedish and able to use it confidently in a professional environment. Swedish citizenship is required.
   

  

 Why? Most of our collaborations and client projects are conducted in Swedish, and several of our clients have formal requirements for both Swedish citizenship and full professional fluency in the language.
   

  

 Let's Play!
   

  

 Applying to us is a breeze!
   

  

* Upload your resumé or use your Linkedin profile
* Answer the choice-questions (no "please-rewrite-your-resume" nonsense, promise)
* Feel free to include links to your portfolio, GitHub or similar if you have stuff you're proud of that you want to share with us


**Note**
 Playground Group does not provide visa sponsorship or relocation support.
   

  

 For this role applicants must have a swedish citizenship
   

  

 Welcome to Playground!
   

  

 At Playground, you work on real, complex assignments for well-established and ambitious clients, not bench projects or short-lived experiments. Our teams are trusted with production systems, platforms, and data that actually matter. Here growth comes from ownership, curiosity, and doing the work properly. You’re trusted to think, contribute, and keep getting better, one meaningful step at a time.
   

  

 Playground brings together specialized domains under one umbrella, with a shared culture and way of working, and easy access to broad technical expertise when it helps move the work forward.

 At Playground Group, we start, own, and grow companies — and the people who lead them. We’re a corporate group with a sharp focus on technology and leadership, built around specialized companies that together form a uniquely strong offering.

title: AI & Data Solution Architect – HR
description:
Do you want to help shape how AI transforms HR? In this newly created position, you combine hands-on technical expertise with a strong architectural mindset to turn business needs into secure, scalable, and valuable AI solutions.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to:
   

  

* Build and shape an AI capability that’s new to HR Technology.
* Work at the forefront of AI while continuously developing your own expertise.
* Take significant ownership while collaborating closely with HR, IT, and architecture specialists.


**About The Job**
 You shape and govern the use of AI across HR Technology. You provide architectural direction for Workday-native capabilities, custom-built solutions and AI agents, ensuring that development aligns with the company’s AI strategy, technology architecture and standards. You report to the Head of HR Technology, with a dotted line to the Manager Architecture Advisory, Enterprise Architect.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Define and maintain the AI strategy and roadmap for HR together with the Head of HR Technology.
* Identify valuable AI opportunities, translate business needs into viable solutions, and lead or contribute to studies, pilots, and implementations.
* Establish architectural and governance principles covering data, privacy, security, documentation, ownership, and lifecycle management.
* Assess development across our global Human Capital Management System Workday and its AI capabilities, as well as other large language models, agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Design how AI interacts with HR systems, enterprise platforms and data sources, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and cost-effective.
* Facilitate workshops, build AI awareness and collaborate with HR, IT, architecture, legal and data privacy specialists.


**Location and flexibility**
 This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm, or Sandviken, with a hybrid setup. For the right candidate, remote work from elsewhere within the CET time zone may be possible.
   

  

**Your profile**
 You bring extensive experience from technical positions and have built AI solutions and worked closely with the technologies and architectural concepts behind them. We place significant value on curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the ambition to continuously develop both your own expertise and how AI can create value across our HR organization.
   

  

 Your background includes
   

  

* Strong knowledge of generative AI, large language models, AI agents, and solution architecture.

title: (Senior) Data Scientist
description:
Insurance is all about life. And it’s all about data. At If we are developing solutions that have the power to turn misfortunes into possibilities and dreams into reality. We are now looking for a Data Scientist or Senior Data Scientist to join a Nordic team focused on developing and productionising machine learning and advanced analytics solutions.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 You will be working in an agile team, which uses AI/ML to support use cases in customer acquisition and sales, customer services operations as well as claims handling and operations. We use a wide set of approaches in our solutions by combining data and software with the use of natural language processing (NLP), image analysis and generative AI, as well as more traditional predictive modelling and classification.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities Include** 



* Driving and developing all aspects of data science solutions for our use cases, from understanding the business problem, transforming and refining the needed data, developing models and pipelines, deploying solutions to production and following up on the quality, performance and retraining of models.
* Steering on stakeholder engagement and ensuring that we are supporting their needs effectively.
* Maintaining a good understanding of If’s data and analytical landscape and guiding the organisation on technical decisions related to AI/ML.
* Collaborating with the team to define the approaches to solutions and iterating on them together. This may include evaluating new methods and technologies in the field.
* Proactively identifying new opportunities to apply or extend solutions related to business needs.
* Coaching more junior data scientists and pushing for best data science practices.



  





**Who are you?** 




 As a Data Scientist or Senior Data Scientist, we think you have a genuine interest in data science and machine learning and you stay curious to their state-of-the-art developments. We expect you may have proven experience and strong understanding in one or several areas ranging from data science, machine learning, data engineering to software engineering. You should be able to drive complex data science solutions to production-level. You are comfortable to steer on the selection of appropriate techniques, tools and approaches for new problems and keen to contribute to If’s analytical and data maturity.
 



  





 We think you are interested in coaching more junior data scientists. You must be able to work and co-operate closely with other data scientists and data/ML engineers as well as advice on complex topics to stakeholders. You should be comfortable to work in a Nordic setting with colleagues of diverse professional and cultural backgrounds.
 



  





**You Also Have** 



* Demonstrated experience and strong understanding in data science and machine learning in a commercial setting.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with version control and software development practices to write reusable modules, models and pipelines to be deployed in test and production environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with stakeholders from all levels of the organisation.
* Interest in data exploration and data development.
* A degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering or a related field.
* Fluency in English.
* Experience with Azure and Databricks is a bonus



  





**About The Team** 




 As part of the Advanced Analytics Chapter you will work together with other data scientists spread across offices in the Nordics in agile teams. We strive to maintain a work environment where you as a data scientist can both develop and be challenged professionally. We are team players with a strong drive forward and the ambition to always deliver the best possible result. You can also read more about how we work with data science and ML in If’s tech blog. https://medium.com/if-tech
 



  





**We offer** 




 Here are some of the benefits of working at If:
 


* An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics

title: MSc Thesis: Automated Interoperability Validation for Healthcare Software
description:
Looking for a thesis project that combines technical challenges with real-world impact? At RaySearch, you'll have the chance to work with talented colleagues and contribute to software that supports cancer treatment around the world. We value curiosity, collaboration, and fresh perspectives, and we see thesis students as an important part of our teams.
   

  

**Project Description**
 Modern radiotherapy relies on the safe and reliable exchange of treatment plans, images, and patient information between systems from different vendors. This communication is typically based on the DICOM standard, but interoperability issues can still occur due to vendor-specific implementations and evolving standards. Detecting these issues is often a manual and time-consuming process.
   

  

 In this thesis, you will explore how DICOM conformance requirements can be transformed into machine-readable validation rules and used to automatically identify interoperability risks.
   

  

 The project combines software engineering, communication protocols, healthcare technology, and data validation, while addressing a real-world challenge in modern cancer care.
   

  

**Your main tasks**
* Design and implement a prototype framework that analyzes DICOM data
* Validate it against standard and vendor-specific requirements, to provide actionable feedback to developers and users.


**Your profile**
 We are looking for a master's student with interest in healthcare technology, communication standards, and software quality.
   

  

* Master of Science student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
* Experience and interest in programming


 It’s an advantage, but not required, if you also have experience of C#/.Net, Knowledge of DICOM, data validation, automated testing, or interoperability standards.

title: Thesis - Energy Mapping and Optimization for Electric Bus Fleets
description:
The Stockholm region is growing rapidly, with increasing numbers of people commuting to, from, and within the county. Rapid population growth and rising passenger expectations require a more attractive and efficient public transport system. The expanding region also creates challenges related to road network capacity, environmental impact, and climate change.
   

  





 The aims not only to provide an attractive public transport experience for existing passengers, but also to strengthen the competitiveness of public transport and encourage more people to choose sustainable travel options. In this way, public transport becomes an important part of solving Stockholm’s future mobility challenges.
   

  





**Background**




 As Stockholm's bus fleet electrifies, energy management becomes a critical operational challenge: heating and cooling alone can account for 30 to 50% of total consumption. This thesis is part of ElbusTransTherm, a KTH research project run in parallel across four theses, one per operator, so your work sits alongside a small cohort of students tackling the same problem from different angles.
   

  





**Purpose**




**Project highlights** 



* Industry data and placement. Work directly with fleet telemetry from a commercial Stockholm public transport operator, and in collaboration with SL.
* A shared cohort. Four parallel theses across different operators mean regular contact with peers, potentially from other technical backgrounds, working the same core problem, with shared methodology and a joint results seminar at the end.
* Applied AI and data science. Large-scale real data analysis and modeling, directly relevant to careers in energy, mobility, and industrial AI.
* Open research problem. Energy mapping and thermal-battery optimization for electric buses is an active, unresolved research area, with outputs intended for operational use. Academic rigour in thesis is ensured through academic supervisor from KTH.



**Method and implementation**




**Phase 1, Energy Mapping.** 
 Develop a detailed empirical breakdown of fleet energy use across drivetrain, HVAC, and auxiliaries, by time of day, season, and route. Deliverable: a data-driven Sankey diagram with quantitative variance analysis identifying key energy drivers.
   

  





**Phase 2, Optimization.** 
 Choose one of three tracks:
 


* **Track A, Passenger-Centric Climate Control:** 
 Dynamic thermal modeling and ISO 7730 comfort analysis to develop adaptive HVAC strategies (preconditioning schedules, adaptive setpoints, comfort-energy decision tools).
* **Track B, Integrated Thermal-Energy Management:** 
 Electro-thermal vehicle modeling linking battery health, powertrain efficiency, and HVAC demand, to reduce energy use and extend battery lifespan.
* **Track C, Managing Operational Phases:** 
 understanding the operational phases in electric bus operations (pre-conditional, dead-heading, in depot etc) and energy consumption across different parameters and optimisation possibilities.



 Both tracks contribute to a reusable data pipeline and analysis methodology intended for operational deployment.
   

  





**Your education and experience**




 Open to students across relevant fields: energy systems, mechanical/thermal engineering, data science, machine learning, electrical engineering, or applied mathematics, with an interest in modeling, optimization, or applied AI, and the ability to work with real-world data.

 The aims not only to provide an attractive public transport experience for existing passengers, but also to strengthen the competitiveness of public transport and encourage more people to choose sustainable travel options. In this way, public transport becomes an important part of solving Stockholm’s future mobility challenges.
   

  

**Background**
 As Stockholm's bus fleet electrifies, energy management becomes a critical operational challenge: heating and cooling alone can account for 30 to 50% of total consumption. This thesis is part of ElbusTransTherm, a KTH research project run in parallel across four theses, one per operator, so your work sits alongside a small cohort of students tackling the same problem from different angles.
   

  

**Purpose**
**Project highlights**
* Industry data and placement. Work directly with fleet telemetry from a commercial Stockholm public transport operator, and in collaboration with SL.
* A shared cohort. Four parallel theses across different operators mean regular contact with peers, potentially from other technical backgrounds, working the same core problem, with shared methodology and a joint results seminar at the end.
* Applied AI and data science. Large-scale real data analysis and modeling, directly relevant to careers in energy, mobility, and industrial AI.
* Open research problem. Energy mapping and thermal-battery optimization for electric buses is an active, unresolved research area, with outputs intended for operational use. Academic rigour in thesis is ensured through academic supervisor from KTH.


**Method and implementation**
**Phase 1, Energy Mapping.** 
 Develop a detailed empirical breakdown of fleet energy use across drivetrain, HVAC, and auxiliaries, by time of day, season, and route. Deliverable: a data-driven Sankey diagram with quantitative variance analysis identifying key energy drivers.
   

  

**Phase 2, Optimization.** 
 Choose one of three tracks:
   

  

* Track A, Passenger-Centric Climate Control: Dynamic thermal modeling and ISO 7730 comfort analysis to develop adaptive HVAC strategies (preconditioning schedules, adaptive setpoints, comfort-energy decision tools).
* Track B, Integrated Thermal-Energy Management: Electro-thermal vehicle modeling linking battery health, powertrain efficiency, and HVAC demand, to reduce energy use and extend battery lifespan.
* Track C, Managing Operational Phases: understanding the operational phases in electric bus operations (pre-conditional, dead-heading, in depot etc) and energy consumption across different parameters and optimisation possibilities.


 Both tracks contribute to a reusable data pipeline and analysis methodology intended for operational deployment.
   

  

**Your Education And Experience**
 Open to students across relevant fields: energy systems, mechanical/thermal engineering, data science, machine learning, electrical engineering, or applied mathematics, with an interest in modeling, optimization, or applied AI, and the ability to work with real-world data.

 Erik Dunkars, Energy Strategist

title: Lead Logs Specialist
description:
**Your role at Dynatrace**
 Dynatrace is seeking a results-driven Log Management Domain Specialist to serve as the primary domain authority for our Log Management solution. This is a high-impact, domain role designed to drive the successful adoption, consumption, and displacement of legacy log tools. You will partner with our Global Sales organization to demonstrate the unique value of the Dynatrace Grail™ data lakehouse, helping customers transition from high-cost, fragmented logging silos to a unified, AI-powered observability platform.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**Domain Expertise:**
* Act as the domain "subject matter expert" (SME) for Logs, staying ahead of industry trends like OpenTelemetry (OTel), log pipelines (Cribl/BindPane), and cloud-native logging (CloudWatch/Stackdriver).
* Articulate the architectural superiority of Dynatrace Grail—specifically how its schema-on-read and index-less storage solve the "cardinality explosion" of modern logs.


**Competitive Execution**
* Partner with Account Executives/SEs to identify and execute displacement plays against legacy incumbents.
* Lead high-stakes Proof of Concepts (POCs) that drive Logs consumption that prove ROI by reducing data ingest costs while increasing troubleshooting speed.
* Build "Economic Value" models that show customers how to optimize their SaaS consumption and maximize their Dynatrace investment.


**Solution Architecture**
* Expertise in architecting resilient, vendor‑neutral log‑ingestion frameworks utilizing Fluentd, Logstash, and OpenTelemetry Collector pipelines, etc.
* Help customers navigate complex log-routing scenarios, ensuring high-value data is prioritized for analytics while low-value data is archived cost-effectively.


**Consumption Advocacy**
* Identify "consumption bottlenecks" within existing accounts and proactively provide technical guidance to unlock more log data volume and user adoption.
* Conduct "Best Practice" workshops focused on log-based alerting, DQL (Dynatrace Query Language) proficiency, and dashboarding.


**What Will Help You Succeed**
**Qualifications & Requirements**
* Experience: 5+ years in a domain, specialist, pre-sales, professional services, or SRE role, with at least 3 years specifically focused on Log Management or Big Data analytics.
* Technical Depth: Advanced proficiency in Query Languages (e.g., Splunk SPL, Kusto QL, SQL, or Lucene).
* Deep understanding of Log Ingestion pipelines and "Telemetry Pipelines" (Cribl, BindPlane, Vector).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, and Serverless logging patterns.
* Cloud & DevOps: Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP logging ecosystems and automation tools like Terraform or Ansible.
* Business Acumen: Ability to translate "bits and bytes" into "dollars and cents"—explaining how log management impacts MTTR and operational overhead.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in - Computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands‑on exposure to modern observability pipelines, including Cribl solutions or OpenTelemetry logging specifications.
* Familiarity with the Cribl ecosystem or OpenTelemetry logging specs.
* Experience with scripting (Python, Go, or Bash) for log transformation and data cleanup.


**Why you will love being a Dynatracer**
* Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
* Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

description:
**DATA STEWARD** 




**Comprehensive Job Description** 




 Role Overview
 



 The Data Steward ensures that the data used for sanctions screening, alert management, case handling, reporting, and watchlist processing is accurate, complete, and fit for purpose. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and testing teams to establish robust data governance, drive data quality, and support successful programme delivery.
 



 What You Will Be Doing
 



 Drive Data Assessment and Discovery
 


* Identify and document source systems providing data to Firco Continuity.
* Assess payment and watchlist data sources to ensure they meet business and regulatory requirements.
* Analyse data quality, completeness, and suitability for sanctions screening processes.
* Produce and maintain data assessment documentation.



 Lead Data Governance and Architecture Activities
 


* Contribute to the design of the target screening data model.
* Define and document data lineage across source systems, screening processes, reporting, and downstream consumers.
* Establish data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, and retention requirements.
* Support development of programme data architecture and reporting framework.



 Own Business Data Definitions and Mapping
 


* Define business meaning and usage of critical data elements.
* Review and approve data mappings for payments, alerts, and case management information.
* Ensure business requirements are accurately reflected in technical specifications.
* Support creation and maintenance of mapping specifications and documentation.



 Champion Data Quality
 


* Define data quality standards, controls, and acceptance criteria.
* Validate payment data and watchlist content throughout implementation lifecycle.
* Review profiling, reconciliation, and validation results.
* Identify, investigate, and drive resolution of data-related issues.



 Support Data Integration and Readiness
 


* Collaborate with architects and engineers on interface and integration requirements.
* Review data transformation logic and interface designs.
* Approve data quality thresholds and production data readiness.
* Support deployment, go-live, and production validation activities.



 Enable Reporting and Operational Transition
 


* Ensure reporting data is accurate, complete, and aligned with business needs.
* Support reporting transitions and operational handover activities.
* Act as a key point of contact for data-related queries and issues during implementation.



 Experience Required
 


* Experience working in data governance, data management, data stewardship, or business data analysis roles.
* Strong understanding of data quality, data lineage, metadata management, and data governance principles.
* Experience with complex system implementations and data integration initiatives.
* Experience within financial services, payments, sanctions, AML, or compliance programmes is highly desirable.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in large transformation programmes.



 Skills and Competencies
 


* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into data specifications and governance controls.
* Understanding of data architecture concepts and source-to-target mappings.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Ability to challenge, influence, and drive decisions across business and technology teams.



 Detailed Technical Knowledge
 


* Data Governance and Stewardship Frameworks
* Data Quality Management and Controls
* Metadata Management
* Data Lineage and Traceability
* Source-to-Target Mapping
* Data Modelling Concepts
* Data Integration and ETL Processes
* Reconciliation and Validation Techniques
* Regulatory Reporting and Audit Requirements
* Financial Crime, Sanctions Screening and AML Data Domains



 Key Stakeholders
 


* Compliance and Financial Crime Teams
* Sanctions Operations
* Business Owners and Product Owners
* Data Architects and Solution Architects
* Data Engineers and Integration Teams
* Test Managers and QA Teams
* Reporting and MI Teams
* Programme Leadership
* Operations and Support Teams



 Success in This Role
 


* Establish trusted and well-governed data for the Firco Continuity platform.
* Ensure data quality standards are achieved before testing and production deployment.
* Deliver complete and approved data lineage and mapping documentation.
* Enable successful production data loads and regulatory-compliant reporting.
* Foster collaboration across business, compliance, technology, and operations teams.



 Reporting Structure

 Domain: Financial Crime, Sanctions Screening, Compliance Technology and Data Governance Transformation Programmes

title: Marketing Automation Specialist - Vikariat 12 månader
description:
**Om Kivra** 




 Vi frågar oss varje dag om det finns ett bättre sätt att samla dina viktiga dokument. För varför hugger vi ner träd som sedan blir till papper i fabriker och transporteras till plåtlådor över hela landet – när det istället går att skicka brev, fakturor och kvitton digitalt.
 



 Över sex miljoner svenskar har redan upptäckt Kivra. Och fler än femtio tusen företag och myndigheter är anslutna. Men vår resa har bara börjat och vi kommer att fortsätta utmana oss för att bli en ännu bättre plats för dina viktigheter.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Vi söker nu en Marketing Automation Specialist som vikarie under en föräldraledighet, med start snarast möjligt och en tidsbegränsad anställning om 12 månader. I rollen kommer du jobba hands-on och strategiskt med CRM-systemet Braze.  Du kommer att strategiskt och proaktivt stötta våra olika affärsområden med att sätta en övergripande plan och utveckla, prioritera samt optimera användarresor. Du spelar en viktig roll i utformning av livscykelkommunikation och kampanjer via segmentering, personalisering och kanalval, samt arbetar aktivt med uppföljning. Du kommer att tillhöra vårt marknadsteam men även ha ett tätt samarbete med bland annat vår produktorganisation.
 



  





**Under dessa 12 månader kommer du att:**

* Sätta upp A/B-tester.

* Bidra till planering och lansering av nya funktioner eller initiativ inom CRM och marketing automation.
* Se till att Braze och dess data hålls i gott skick – medverka vid hantering av incidenter och arbeta för bättre datakvalitet.



  





**Vi ser gärna att du:** 



* Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med Braze i minst 3-4 år, gärna från fler än ett företag, och av att definiera databehov, produktkrav och affärscase för effektiv kommunikation i flera kanaler.

**Meriterande** 



* Har en Level 2 Certified Marketer och Level 2 Certified Administrator.
* Vi ser det extra meriterande ifall du även har erfarenhet från någon / några av Braze Technology Partners såsom Amplitude.

 Under ditt vikariat blir du en del av ett engagerat team med möjlighet till hög innovationsgrad. Du kommer att vara med och påverka Kivras spännande affärs- och produktutveckling av en tjänst som idag används av över halva Sveriges befolkning. På Kivra tror vi på automatisering och på att ligga i framkant genom att ta till oss ny teknik, och AI är inget undantag. title: 30 hp Master Thesis: PhysicsAI versus Design of Experiments
description:
30 hp Master Thesis: PhysicsAI versus Design of Experiments
   

  

 Introduction
   

  

 Scania’s purpose is to drive the shift towards a sustainable transport system, creating a world of mobility better for business, society, and the environment. Exploring and accelerating the development of tomorrow's transport system is one of the driving forces. Imagine you could impact the next generation Scania vehicles by working in a dynamic and diverse workplace. Yes, this opportunity gives you significant exposure to the vehicle development process.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to develop your engineering skills, to learn if the Scania work culture suits your future career goals and to show your abilities and talents over 20 weeks of thesis work.
   

  

 Background
   

  

 Simulation and testing are core parts of the development process for next generation of vehicles and have been so for many years. To accurately predict or verify results is key. Over the years simulation has played a larger role in the development process and in providing faster design iterations.
   

  

 A traditional way of exploring the design space is to use Design of Experiments, (DOE). In DOE, selected input parameters are varied to explore their effect on selected system outputs. In contrast to trial-and-error, this allows for systematic studies of different design parameters. For complex models with many parameters, this is usually a time-consuming process.
   

  

 The emergence of AI and machine learning could possibly offer an interesting alternative to DOE. Training an AI model on design parameters could allow for the optimization of selected system outputs. However, due to the maturity state of the technology, several questions regarding how this compares to the more traditional method remains to be fully understood.
   

  

**Objective And Job Description**
 Main focus of the work will be to train and evaluate how the AI model performs with respect to design optimization as compared to a traditional DOE approach/adjoint based optimization. This will be done by optimizing a fan installation with geometric deep learning in PhysicsAI and then evaluate the methodology and the performance of the fan installation to that obtained by DOE through Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations.
   

  

 The thesis project will require work in both Windows and Linux environments, work with python code and running CFD simulations through STAR-CCM+ on high-performance computing clusters.
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Final year pursuing a master's degree in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering or equivalent and with a specialization in Fluid Dynamics.
   

  

 Experience from working on computer cluster environments with Linux interface, unsteady state simulations, and exposure to scripting simulation workflow are desirable. Knowledge in STAR-CCM+ and Python is beneficial as well as having a genuine interest in CFD.
   

  

 Number of students
   

  

 1 - 2
   

  

 Start date
   

  

 January (exact dates can be discussed later) and estimated time required is 20 weeks.
   

  

 Contact persons and supervisors
   

  

 Supervisor, Eric Axtelius (TGRMST1), eric.axtelius@scania.com
   

  

 Manager, Joakim Lindholm (TGRMST1), joakim.lindholm@scania.com
   

  

 Application
   

  

 Your application must include a CV, personal letter, and transcript of grades.
   

  

 A background check might be conducted for this position. We conduct interviews continuously and may close the recruitment earlier than the date specified.
