title: CAD-konstruktör / Resident Engineer – fordonsindustrin, Göteborg
description:
Nu letar vi efter en CAD-konstruktör / Resident Engineer till ESSIQ Väst! ESSIQ är arbetsgivaren som anstränger sig lite extra för att du ska må bra. Vad är medarbetarfokus för dig? På ESSIQ handlar det om att sätta medarbetaren i centrum. Genom ett lyhört ledarskap och en öppen företagskultur vill vi ge varje medarbetare möjligheten att forma sin karriär och sin vardag.


Till den här rollen söker vi dig som har erfarenhet av CAD-konstruktion inom fordonsindustrin och som är redo för nya utmaningar. Ser du fördelarna med att få variation och erfarenhet från olika kunder och branscher men att utvecklas med en och samma arbetsgivare? Som medarbetare på ESSIQ får du det bästa av två världar.

**ROLLBESKRIVNING**  

Som CAD-konstruktör / Resident Engineer arbetar du på plats hos vår kund, en global leverantör av fluid- och bränslesystem till fordonsindustrin. Du blir länken mellan leverantören och fordonstillverkaren och ansvarar för att konstruktionsunderlag, CAD-modeller och ändringar hanteras korrekt och i rätt tid. I rollen konstruerar och uppdaterar du komponenter och installationer för rör- och fluidsystem i 3D-CAD, gör packaging- och installationsstudier i fordonsmiljö, driver ändringsärenden och håller ordning på dokumentation och releaser. Du samordnar också löpande mellan fordonstillverkarens tekniska team och leverantörens organisation.


Vi förväntar oss att du har ett användarcentrerat, lösningsorienterat arbetssätt och att du är öppen, nytänkande och professionell. En anställning hos oss innebär både trygghet och frihet, där vi stöttar dig så mycket som du vill och behöver. För oss är det viktigt att du får vara delaktig i att forma din karriärväg och att du är med och påverkar ESSIQ som företag och arbetsplats.

**KVALIFIKATIONER**  

Vi letar inte efter anställda, vi letar efter medarbetare – efter ESSIQ:are! Nedanstående är de grundläggande kvalifikationerna för tjänsten, men vi kommer även lägga stor vikt vid din personlighet.


Grundläggande kvalifikationer

* Civil- eller högskoleingenjör inom maskinteknik eller motsvarande
* Minimum 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av CAD-konstruktion, eller annan erfarenhet vi bedömer relevant
* Mycket god kunskap inom 3D-CAD, gärna CATIA V5 eller 3DEXPERIENCE
* Erfarenhet från fordonsindustrin, gärna av rör-, slang- eller fluidsystem
* Van vid ändringshantering och arbete i PLM-miljö, t.ex. KOLA, Teamcenter eller Enovia
* Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


Meriterande

* Erfarenhet av rollen som resident engineer, eller av att arbeta som kontaktyta mellan leverantör och fordonstillverkare
* Erfarenhet från leverantörssidan i fordonsindustrin


Personlighet och engagemang

* Du är ansvarstagande – kommer i mål, i medvind likväl som i motvind.
* Du är social och kommunikativ – öppen och tydlig gentemot dina kollegor, och är en produktiv problemlösare. Du är bra på att föra samtal om dig, arbetsteamet och leveransen inför en eller flera åhörare.
* Du är lyhörd och hjälpsam – tar in kunskap från omvärld och kollegor, och delar gärna med dig av din egen. Du är generös med tips, hjälp och stöd.

**OM TJÄNSTEN**

* Anställningsform: tillsvidareanställning på heltid. 6 månaders provanställning tillämpas.
* Tillträde: november 2026 eller enligt överenskommelse.
* Lön och förmåner: Konkurrenskraftig fast eller rörlig lön. Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och generösa förmåner. Tjänstepension, omfattande försäkringar.
* Placering: ESSIQ Väst – på plats hos kund i Göteborg.

**OM ESSIQ**  

ESSIQ är teknikkonsultföretaget där allt börjar med dig. Med fokus på individen, flexibla lösningar och en modern lönepolicy attraherar vi de skarpaste, mest professionella och engagerade personerna i branschen. Med denna vision grundades ESSIQ år 2005, sedan dess har vi utvecklats till ett framgångsrikt företag med kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi består idag av över 250 medarbetare med olika bakgrund, personlighet och nationalitet, med en god fördelning av kvinnor och män.


Vi har över 80 aktiva kunder i spännande branscher – allt från de stora aktörerna till de små innovationsföretagen. ESSIQ:s medarbetare arbetar med användarcentrerad tjänste- och produktutveckling inom följande tjänsteområden: UX & Service Design, Connected & Embedded Systems, IT & Cloud Services, Green Technology & Electromobility, Test & Quality Engineering, Agile Management, Mechanical Engineering samt Simulation & Visualization. Kompetensen levererar vi på plats hos uppdragsgivaren, inhouse och i satellit. Våra medarbetares intressen och ambitioner leder vägen – vårt mål är att göra den perfekta matchningen av individ och uppdrag.


ESSIQ är ett familjärt och socialt företag med visionen att vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för alla medarbetare, oavsett roll i organisationen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid gemenskap och har ett uppskattat utbud av professionella och sociala aktiviteter. Vår kommunikationsplattform genomsyras av öppenhet, och främjar nätverkande och kompetensutbyte såväl som fritidsaktiviteter och relationsbyggande.

**ANSÖKAN**  

Vi använder oss av rekryteringsverktyget Teamtailor. Ansök senast den 25/10-2026. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

**KONTAKT**  

Frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta: Henrik Vidarsson, henrik.vidarsson@essiq.se, +46 (0)705-218142.  

Vill du veta mer om ESSIQ?  

Besök http://essiq.se och följ oss på våra sociala medier!

###### **Job Description**


Close to one million film lovers already choose SF Anytime. Your job: make them come back for more. We are looking for a hands-on Head of Commercial Product who wants to build our retention engine and the team behind it.


**Who we are**

SF Anytime, part of SF Studios, is a leading video-on-demand service across the Nordics and Baltics. We offer the world’s largest movie library with more than 15,000 films and series, from the latest Hollywood releases to local Nordic favourites, both directly to viewers and through operator partnerships. With the acquisition of Blockbuster Denmark, we are now accelerating growth and bringing our services together across markets.


We have close to one million active users, strong studio relationships and a proven customer acquisition engine. Now we are building the other half of the equation: a data-driven retention and growth engine that turns one-time buyers into loyal, returning customers. That’s where you come in.


**What you will step into**

You will own the customer experience, from the moment a user lands on our platform to the moment they come back for more. Your mission: grow revenue from our existing customers. You own the storefront, the marketing automation system, all customer communication and our commercial product experiences across web, app and TV. This is a hands-on leadership role in a small team.


It requires strategic thinking in combination with an operational approach: running pricing tests, optimising conversion and driving experiments, while setting the direction and moving the team forward.


You will be part of SF Anytime’s management team, reporting directly to the EVP & General Manager. You will partner closely with our CTO and platform teams as the commercial and customer voice in product development.


The role is based in our office in Hagastaden, Stockholm.


**What you will own**

* Lead and build up a high-performing cross-functional team with number of transactions per user and repurchase rate as your north star.
* Own the end-to-end user journey on all platforms, including all customer communication and the marketing automation system.
* Set the direction together with our marketing automation specialists to optimise segmentation, lifecycle flows and personalised messaging that drive repurchase and transactions per customer.
* Drive conversion and UX optimisation together with Marketing and Acquisition, turning visitors into buyers and buyers into regulars.
* Lead structured experiments and testing on pricing and campaign logic, using AI and data.
* Lead and set the commercial product roadmap in close collaboration with the CTO.

**We believe you are**

Commercially driven and data-focused, you love turning insight into action. You get energy from driving growth and putting AI to work, and your entrepreneurial mindset means you create structure and deliver tangible results. As a leader, you drive change with confidence, develop others and bring people along on the journey. Your background includes:


* Extensive experience in digital growth and e-commerce, with a proven track record of growing revenue from existing customers.
* Hands-on experience in a product growth role, for example as Growth Product Manager, Conversion Manager or Product Manager, owning the storefront and the end-to-end buyer journey together with marketing, engineers and designers.
* Background in marketing automation, conversion rate optimisation, experimentation and customer lifecycle management.
* Experience as a product owner or commercial counterpart to an engineering team.
* Proven experience leading and developing teams, ideally cross-functional, with clear goals and KPIs.
* Fluency in Swedish and English.

**What we offer**

At SF Anytime, you get real ownership from day one. You will work closely with the EVP & General Manager and an engaged team across marketing, content and product & tech, building on years of behavioural data on Nordic film consumers and an established acquisition engine.


You will also join SF Studios, one of the Nordics’ most established entertainment companies, working alongside people with deep expertise across film and TV production, distribution, IT and finance, all united by a passion for great content. If you combine a strong business mindset with a love for film and TV, we know you will feel right at home.


**Ready to join us?**

Sound like your next big move? Apply today – we look forward to hearing from you. For questions, please contact Katarina Werner, EVP & General Manager of SF Anytime.


###### **About the company**


SF Studios, founded in 1919, is one of the world’s oldest film companies and the leading film studio in the Nordic region. Its business includes production and distribution of feature films and TV series and the streaming platform SF Anytime. SF Studios has its head office in Stockholm, Sweden and subsidiaries in Oslo, Copenhagen and Helsinki, and is part of the leading Nordic media company Bonnier AB.

title: Master´s thesis – Understanding and Designing for User Intent in Industrial AI Interfaces
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


R&D Team Lead **Your role and responsibilities**

As agentic AI-based knowledge and decision support systems become increasingly advanced in industry, they operate with greater autonomy and proactivity than traditional tools, taking independent actions based on user intent rather than providing solely recommendations.

  

This fundamentally changes how control room operators interact with distributed control systems (DCS), shifting from explicit commands to expressing intentions, goals, and constraints something the AI must interpret and act upon. The "articulation barrier" describes the difficulty operators experience when translating complex operational knowledge into interactions the system can meaningfully act upon. When operators struggle to articulate their intentions clearly, the AI may misinterpret objectives, leading to misaligned actions, reduced trust in the system, and diminished interaction efficiency.

  

This master's thesis investigates how industrial operators formulate, communicate, and refine their intentions when interacting with advanced agentic AI systems, and how user experience design can reduce the articulation barrier. You will design guidelines for intent-supporting interaction in control room environments, with an option to focus alternatively on mobile operators working in the field.

 *Recommended research questions are (can be some of the following):*

* *How can interfaces proactively support intent formulation without increasing cognitive load on users?*
* *How to support going from intentions into actionable insights?*
* *What factors are important to consider when designing for user intent in an industrial environment e.g. noise, different light conditions, safety aspects, risk of information overload, stressful situations?*
* *How can users be motivated to give additional information when desired?*
* *How should AI agents’ communication style change during different types of situations, e.g. the operator has a lot to do or too little, the user needs to work in several different systems etc.?*
* *(if the thesis has focus on use in a control room) How can user experiences be designed for an information- and system-intensive environment?*
* *(if thesis has focus on mobile use) How can mobile user experiences be designed to support effective AI interaction outside of the control room?*

 **Details:**

* Spring 2027, commonly between Jan-July
* 30 ECTS/högskolepoäng (hp)
* 1-2 students
* In Västerås. Possibility for hybrid workplace

 **Your responsibilities**

* Conduct a literature review covering how to support user intent communication and interaction with an agentic AI system in an industrial context
* Do user research through interviews, workshops, contextual studies, or discussions with ABB experts and/ or end users
* Identify user needs, pain points, and use cases
* Formulate and summarize important factors to consider during design to lower the interaction barriers
* Investigate relevant market solutions for the industrial market, designed to support capture of user intent during interaction
* Develop concepts and user experience visions for future human-agent interaction with focus on user intent
* Create interactive mid-fidelity prototypes demonstrating selected concepts and use cases
* Evaluate concepts with users or domain experts and collect feedback
* Summarize findings and provide design recommendations for intent-supporting human-agent interaction

 **Your background**


We are looking for motivated master's students interested in designing future industrial user experiences and digital solutions.

  

Candidates could have:

* **Academic Background** in one or more of the following fields:
	+ Interaction Design
	+ Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)
	+ User Experience (UX) Design
	+ Industrial Design Engineering
	+ Human Factors Engineering
	+ Computer Science
	+ Cognitive Science or Cognitive Systems
	+ Media Technology
* Interest in user-centered design, digital product development, and emerging technologies
* Ability to conduct qualitative user research and translate findings into requirements, concepts, and design recommendations
* Experience creating prototypes and visual concepts using tools such as Figma or similar.
* Ability to work independently and creatively in an exploratory research environment
* Interest in industrial automation, process industries, AI-assisted systems, or industrial digitalization is considered a strong merit

 **More about us**


Recruiting Manager Dawid Ziobro, dawid.ziobro@se.abb.com, will answer your questions.

  

Apply with your CV, academic transcripts and a cover letter in English.


We look forward to receiving your application!


A future opportunity


This role is part of our talent pipeline, which means it’s not currently open, but we’re always looking for curious minds, bold thinkers, and people who want to make an impact.


Click Apply to express your interest and be considered for future opportunities that match your experience and aspirations.


At ABB, we welcome people from all backgrounds and believe that diverse perspectives help us build a cleaner, smarter future.


Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about how we help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:


R&D Team Lead **Your role and responsibilities**


Industrial automation systems have traditionally been designed around the control room, where operators supervise, diagnose, and control industrial processes through dedicated Distributed Control System (DCS) workstations. However, many operational tasks take place outside the control room. Operators perform plant walkarounds, maintenance personnel troubleshoot equipment in the field, and service engineers provide on-site or remote support. These situations often require access to process information while users are mobile, yet current solutions are typically constrained by fixed workstations, fragmented tools, or limited mobile functionality.

  

At the same time, advances in mobile technologies, edge computing, industrial connectivity, and AI-assisted decision support create new opportunities for extending process awareness beyond the control room. Mobile devices can provide contextual information, real-time process insights, guided workflows, and collaboration capabilities directly where work is performed. Future solutions may not only replicate existing DCS functionality on a smaller screen, but redefine how industrial personnel interact with automation systems while on the move.

  

This thesis will explore how next-generation mobile user experiences can support process supervision, troubleshooting, maintenance, and decision-making in industrial environments. The student will investigate user needs, identify key use cases, study current and emerging technologies, and develop concepts or prototypes for future mobile solutions within ABB's automation ecosystem.

 *Recommended research questions are (can be some of the following):*

* *How can mobile user experiences be designed to support safe and effective access to process information outside the control room?*
* *What information and functionality do operators, technicians, and service engineers need when interacting with a DCS in the field?*
* *How can AI-assisted insights, recommendations, and contextual guidance improve decision-making in mobile industrial environments?*
* *How should future mobile solutions support collaboration between control room personnel, field technicians, and remote experts?*
* *What technical and communication requirements must be considered when extending DCS capabilities to mobile platforms?*

 **Details:**

* Spring 2027, commonly between Jan-July
* 30 ECTS/högskolepoäng (hp)
* 1-2 students
* In Västerås, possibility for hybrid workplace

 **Your responsibilities**

* Conduct a literature review covering mobile interaction in industrial environments, mobile operator solutions, human factors, AI-assisted decision support, and remote collaboration.
* Investigate current ABB offerings and relevant market solutions for mobile access to automation and process information.
* Conduct user research through interviews, workshops, contextual studies, or discussions with ABB experts and end users.
* Identify user needs, pain points, workflows, and key use cases for mobile process supervision and support.
* Analyze technical and communication requirements associated with identified use cases.
* Develop concepts and user experience visions for next-generation mobile DCS solutions.
* Create interactive prototypes demonstrating selected concepts and use cases.
* Evaluate concepts with users or domain experts and collect feedback.
* Summarize findings and provide design recommendations for future ABB mobile offerings.

 **Your background**


We are looking for motivated master's students interested in designing future industrial user experiences and digital solutions.

  

Candidates could have:

* **Academic Background** in one or more of the following fields:
	+ Interaction Design
	+ Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)
	+ User Experience (UX) Design
	+ Industrial Design Engineering
	+ Human Factors Engineering
	+ Computer Science
	+ Cognitive Science or Cognitive Systems
	+ Media Technology
* Interest in user-centered design, digital product development, and emerging technologies.
* Ability to conduct qualitative user research and translate findings into requirements, concepts, and design recommendations.
* Experience creating prototypes and visual concepts using tools such as Figma or similar.
* Ability to work independently and creatively in an exploratory research environment.
* Interest in industrial automation, process industries, AI-assisted systems, or industrial digitalization is considered a strong merit.

Recruiting Manager Dawid Ziobro, dawid.ziobro@se.abb.com, will answer your questions.

title: Master’s thesis – Contextual visualization and extension marketplace design for ABB Crealizer
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


R&D Team Lead **Your role and responsibilities**


ABB Crealizer™ lets users develop applications for ABB drives. After an application is created and validated, its outputs still need to be explained in the context of the task: what the application observed, what changed, why it matters, and how its results can be shown to colleagues, customers or management. An interactive browser view could help users explore those results and demonstrate the application’s value.

  

This thesis will use one working Crealizer™ application supplied by ABB as its case. The student will design, build, and evaluate a contextual visualization of its data and results. A smaller, connected part of the thesis will explore how that visualization solution could become a reusable extension for other applications. This would require the student to develop a connected UX concept for a future Crealizer™ marketplace, covering how users discover, assess, and configure extensions and how contributors share them.

  

Recommended research questions are:


1. What information do application creators and intended viewers need to understand and demonstrate this application’s results?


2. How can an interactive browser view combine data, task context, and explanation to communicate those results clearly and credibly?


3. What design and technical requirements would make the visualization reusable, and how should a future Crealizer™ marketplace help users discover, assess, configure, and share such extensions?

 **Details:**


Start: Jan-June 2027, approximately six months of project work, exact dates to be agreed


30 ECTS/högskolepoäng (hp)


Place: ABB CRC (Västerås), with possibility of hybrid work


ABB may cover the accommodation in Västerås  

  

**Your responsibilities**

* Explore the selected Crealizer™ application, its available data, intended audience, and visualization value.
* Interview ABB experts and, if access permits, external users to understand how application results are interpreted, demonstrated, and shared. Review relevant visualization and storytelling approaches, then define design requirements and testable novel visualization concepts that bring value.
* Translate the application’s data into a contextual interactive view. Use approved or sanitized data where needed, and identify essential context and interaction points, build a browser-based proof of concept that helps the intended audience understand the value of the Crealizer™ application and its results.
* Evaluate and improve design of the proof of concept with representative users or domain experts.
* Define and prototype how the visualization function could work as a configurable extension for other Crealizer™ applications, including its data inputs and setup requirements.
* Develop a preliminary marketplace design concept covering organization and discovery, extension information and trust cues, configuration, and contributor sharing flows.
* Document the findings, design implications, and technical know-how; and present the results to ABB stakeholders.
* Follow ABB’s health, safety, information security, and research integrity requirements throughout the thesis.

 **Your background**


We welcome motivated master’s students with a background in one or more of the following areas:

* Interaction design, human–computer interaction, data visualization, media technology, computer science, or related engineering studies.
* Ability to plan user research and translate findings into clear design requirements.
* Experience building and testing interactive prototypes, including front-end development and the use of AI-assisted design or development tools.
* Interest in turning technical data into clear visualizations that help different audiences understand an application’s value.
* Systems thinking and sound scoping - ability to connect one visualization to reusable system capabilities, collaborate with technical experts, and define a feasible thesis scope.
* Interest in industrial automation; prior knowledge of drive engineering is an advantage but not required.

 **More about us (Mandatory)**  

Recruiting Manager Dawid Ziobro, dawid.ziobro@se.abb.com, can answer questions about the application process. For questions about the thesis topic, contact ABB thesis supervisor Yemao Man at yemao.man@se.abb.com.

title: Global Design & UX Lead
description:
**HAYPP GROUP**


At Haypp Group, we address one of the world's biggest public health challenges: smoking. With more than one billion smokers globally and millions of smoking-related deaths every year, our mission is to inspire and accelerate the shift towards smoke-free enjoyment by making alternative nicotine products more accessible online.


Haypp Group is a global e-commerce leader in smoke-free nicotine alternatives, operating 17 digital storefronts across seven markets and serving more than one million active customers worldwide. Through a portfolio of eleven consumer-facing brands, including Northerner, Snusbolaget, Nicokick and Haypp, we are helping drive the transition from smoking to less harmful alternatives.


Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, our team of approximately 300 people globally combines expertise in e-commerce, technology, product development, design, and digital marketing. As a truly international business, we operate across multiple markets, languages, brands, and customer journeys, creating unique opportunities to build consistent, scalable, and customer-centric experiences on a global scale.

**THE ROLE**


We're looking for our first Global Design & UX Lead at Haypp Group. This is a unique opportunity to establish and scale design across a complex international ecosystem of products, platforms, customer journeys, and markets, creating a shared vision for how millions of customers experience our digital storefronts.


As Haypp Group continues to grow internationally across multiple brands and markets, we've established a global Brand team to strengthen consistency and brand identity across the business. We are now looking for a design leader who can bring the same strategic approach to our digital customer experience.


Reporting to the Head of Product, you will own the global UX and design vision across our brands, products, and customer journeys. You will play a key role in building a scalable design practice, establishing a global design system, and ensuring a seamless user experience across markets while balancing local needs with global consistency. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and Commercial teams, you will drive design excellence, champion user-centred thinking, and help shape how millions of customers interact with our products and brands. You will also help future-proof how we work by leveraging emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and modern SaaS platforms to improve design effectiveness and customer outcomes.


This role is ideal for an experienced design professional who is ready to take the next step into a broader, more strategic leadership role, while still enjoying hands-on involvement in design and customer experience


Hybrid work model with in-office collaboration Tuesday to Thursday at our Stockholm office on Södermalm, balancing flexibility with strong team connection.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Own and evolve the global UX and design vision across Haypp Group's brands and digital products
* Establish and scale a global design system across markets, platforms, and storefronts
* Define design principles, governance models, and ways of working across teams
* Drive user-centred design through research, testing, insights, and performance data
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Brand, and Commercial stakeholders globally
* Ensure consistent and seamless customer experiences across brands, platforms, and markets
* Mentor designers and strengthen design capabilities and maturity across the organization
* Connect design decisions to business outcomes including conversion, retention, and engagement
* Stay at the forefront of emerging design technologies, AI capabilities, and SaaS platforms, helping shape how Haypp leverages new tools, workflows, and ways of working

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 6-10 years of experience in Product Design, UX Design, Digital Design, or related fields, including experience leading projects, teams, or design practices
* Proven experience building and scaling design systems across multiple products, brands, or markets
* Experience leading designers through direct people management or senior design leadership
* Strong understanding of UX, interaction design, user research, design operations, and customer journeys
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and Commercial teams
* Strong understanding of modern design ecosystems, including design tools, AI-powered workflows, and SaaS platforms
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution when needed
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills
* Experience from e-commerce, digital consumer products, marketplaces, or similar environments is highly valued
* Fluent in English

**YOU WILL PROBABLY THRIVE HERE IF YOU**

* Enjoy building and scaling design capabilities, frameworks, and teams
* Combine strong design thinking with commercial understanding and business impact
* Enjoy creating clarity, structure, and alignment in growing organizations
* Are curious about emerging technologies and excited by the opportunities AI can create for teams and customers

**WHAT WE OFFER**


We are a value-driven company with our values **We Team Up, Innovation Drives Us, Inclusion and Non-Hierarchy, and Going the Extra Mile** at the heart of everything we do.


At Haypp Group, you can always expect supportive colleagues who want to achieve things together and a culture where everyone's voice matters. We encourage ideas from all parts of the organization and are not afraid to try new things. At the same time, we celebrate achievements and recognize the hard work that goes into reaching them.


Because our people are our most important differentiator, we offer generous benefits including:

* Competitive occupational pension
* Insurance plan, including private healthcare
* 30 days of paid vacation
* Parental pay lift
* Wellness allowance of 5,000 SEK per year
* Regular social activities and team events

**SEND US YOUR APPLICATION TODAY**


If this sounds like a place where you would want to contribute and grow, we would love to hear from you. Haypp Group is committed to equality and diversity and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or marital status.

title: Product Owner – Buying & Data/AI (Fixed-Term)
description:
Tradera is a purpose-driven company with a belief that consumption has a large impact on our planet. We're determined to use what we control (our business, our voice, our creativity and our platform) to do something about it. At Tradera, we're on a mission to "Drive the Transition to Sustainable Shopping" by shifting the way people consume and resell preloved goods.


We're now looking for a Product Owner to lead two of our teams: Buying, which shapes the buying journey across tradera.com and our iOS and Android apps, and Data/AI, which builds Tradera's own AI models.


This is a fixed-term employment contract (Sw. särskild visstidsanställning) running from February 2027 to January 2028. We work with a hybrid policy and we'd like you to be at our Stockholm office at least 2-3 days a week.

**About the Role**


The Buying team's mission is to make buying second-hand as seamless and enjoyable as buying new. The Data/AI team builds AI that makes a difference wherever it can, for our users and internally. Today that includes search, recommendations and making it easier to list items on Tradera. The team works closely with Buying and the rest of the product organization.


As Product Owner, you'll work closely with our CPO and have a central role in the organization, collaborating with stakeholders across the company.


We care a lot about getting things done. In this role, success is about what the team ships together and the difference it makes for our users.


You'll be team lead and people manager for 7 people across both teams. You'll help them grow, build good collaboration and keep the teams focused on what matters most. Priorities can change quickly here, so you're comfortable adapting and helping the team keep its focus.

**What You'll Do**

* Shape features and improvements that make second-hand shopping as simple and enjoyable as buying new.
* Set direction for the Data/AI team across every area where AI can make a difference, both for our users and internally at Tradera.
* Prioritize the backlogs for both teams, balancing user feedback, bug fixes, AI initiatives and new features.
* Plan and ship updates across web, apps and our AI/data platform together with the teams.
* Work closely with developers, UX/design, analysts, marketing and other product teams.
* Support and develop the people in your teams through feedback, coaching and regular 1:1s.

**Who Are You?**


You like getting things done and get your energy from seeing a team succeed together. You're curious about what AI can do for a product.


We think you have:

* Experience leading a team, as a people manager or in another leading role.
* Experience prioritizing work based on user needs and business impact.
* Experience working with developers and other teams.
* Fluency in both Swedish and English.


Experience with data, ML or AI products is a plus, but not a requirement.


Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about how you work and what you can bring to the team than about matching a list.

**Why Join Tradera?**


At Tradera, you'll work on meaningful projects that contribute to sustainable shopping, together with a talented team. You'll play a key role in making second-hand the easy and enjoyable choice, and in shaping how AI helps people find, buy and sell preloved goods.


Come and join us. Don't be square, get circular!

title: Software Engineer - Application Services
description:
10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.


With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.


Founded in 2022, and with 1000+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, an HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.

**About the role**


Join our expanding Engagement area and play a key role in the Application Services team as a Software Engineer (in-house, full-time), creating, expanding, and maintaining web and mobile apps that create an exceptional Aira experience.  

  

The Application Services team's focus is on creating world-class product-driven software for both our customers—end users of Aira’s green energy tech—and our internal users, such as Aira heat pump installers.  

  

On one hand, these apps need to be clean, easy to use and intuitive to enable effortless UX. However, at the same time, they must integrate, distribute, and efficiently manage multi-channel live data points (including IoT) and offer them internally via APIs to enable Aira product readiness in daily operations and support customers in making informed energy decisions.


This is a Software Engineer role, back-end heavy, with front-end sense & experience needed to be involved in technical discussions to push the product development forward.

**What is the role about?**

* Writing, maintaining and enhancing clean, scalable code including thorough testing
* Using **Kotlin** to design, implement and maintain back-end services that serve the app and distribute the data in microservice architecture
* Building real-time streaming data pipelines and real-time streaming applications with **Kafka**
* Collaborating with other Aira Engagement teams (Connectivity, IoT), and implementing integrations with e.g., external energy tariffs providers and upcoming projects related to expanding Aira green tech solutions portfolio
* Demonstrating expertise in system architecture, **(relational and non-relational) database** design, **AWS** cloud operations as well as **building and integrating APIs**
* Actively engaging in ongoing discussions regarding design and device lifecycles
* Applying **Agile** methodologies and collaborating in cross-functional teams
* Optional: Contributing to the implementation of app features using **Flutter**, including handling user accounts, providing, and supporting integrations with Identity Providers for both installers and customers

**What are we looking for?**

* Mid to Senior profile with 5+ years of experience in Software Engineer role (back-end heavy)
* Proficiency in Kotlin, Java Spring Boot, AWS, Kafka is preferable, but we are flexible - e.g. experience in Go, Node.JS or Java for back-end is sufficient too.
* Experience in product-driven development, microservices, building & integrating APIs, system architecture, database design, and software development principles
* Right seniority and mindset to take on responsibility, and ownership and enable mission-critical discussions
* Availability and openness to work from the office - currently we aim at 4 days a week on-site model
* Front-end proficiency in Flutter, Angular is nice to have

**What's in it for you?**

* Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
* Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
* Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
* Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
* Enjoy working in our brand new office. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan subway station just a few minutes walk away.


Aira leads in the next generation of Energy. We are driven by our belief that the power of diversity fuels innovation. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives to join our team, united in our mission to create a better future for society and the planet.

title: UX/UI designer, WeTransfer
description:
WeTransfer helps millions of users share ideas and collaborate seamlessly. Now part of Bending Spoons, it plays a key role in a portfolio of outstanding digital businesses united by a shared focus on innovation and operational excellence. By applying through the WeTransfer brand, you’ll be stepping into the wider Bending Spoons team. You may work directly on WeTransfer or contribute to one of our other leading products. Either way, you’ll be part of a high-performing, collaborative environment where you can make a real impact.
   

  

 At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.
   

  

 To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we operate so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator.
   

  

 For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.
   

  

**A few examples of your responsibilities** 
* **Shape high-leverage product experiences.** 
 Design exceptional UI and UX—from early concepts to polished delivery—using the best available tools to explore more directions, move faster, and raise the quality bar. Ensure every experience is intuitive, effective, and delightful.
* **Start with an LLM.** 
 Use AI tools to clarify intent, draft short specs, and surface risks, edge cases, and initial approaches before opening any design tool. Use this work to align quickly with your team and compress the time from ambiguity to direction.
* **Prototype and build with AI.** 
 Use Cursor and Claude Code to turn rough concepts into interactive prototypes and generate production-ready frontend code. You know when to reach for code and when to reach for Figma—and you move fluidly between both to get the best result.
* **Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one.** 
 Define UX requirements early, stay in the build through QA and release, and make engineering-aware design decisions.
* **Validate and measure.** 
 Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and use what you learn to adjust direction. Track funnels, retention, and adoption to assess design effectiveness and sharpen what ships next.
* **Find the highest-leverage bets from the backlog.** 
 Identify where product improvements can unlock business value, align stakeholders around them, and move fast to deliver.


**What we look for** 
* **Reasoning ability.** 
 Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
* **Drive.** 
 You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
* **Team spirit.** 
 You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
* **Proficiency in English.** 
 You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


**What we offer** 
* **Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.** 
 You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
* **An exceptional opportunity for growth.** 
 We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
* **Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.** 
 Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able to receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
* **All. These. Benefits.** 
 Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.


**Commitment & contract**
 Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.
   

  

**Location**
 Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.
   

  

**The selection process**
 In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.
   

  

 Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.
   

  

 All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.
   

  

 We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.
   

  

 We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.
   

  

**Before you apply**
 If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.
   

  

 Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.
   

  

 To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.
   

  

 If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Global Design & UX Lead
description:
**HAYPP GROUP**
 At Haypp Group, we address one of the world's biggest public health challenges: smoking. With more than one billion smokers globally and millions of smoking-related deaths every year, our mission is to inspire and accelerate the shift towards smoke-free enjoyment by making alternative nicotine products more accessible online.
   

  

 Haypp Group is a global e-commerce leader in smoke-free nicotine alternatives, operating 17 digital storefronts across seven markets and serving more than one million active customers worldwide. Through a portfolio of eleven consumer-facing brands, including Northerner, Snusbolaget, Nicokick and Haypp, we are helping drive the transition from smoking to less harmful alternatives.
   

  

 Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, our team of approximately 300 people globally combines expertise in e-commerce, technology, product development, design, and digital marketing. As a truly international business, we operate across multiple markets, languages, brands, and customer journeys, creating unique opportunities to build consistent, scalable, and customer-centric experiences on a global scale.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 We're looking for our first Global Design & UX Lead at Haypp Group. This is a unique opportunity to establish and scale design across a complex international ecosystem of products, platforms, customer journeys, and markets, creating a shared vision for how millions of customers experience our digital storefronts.
   

  

 As Haypp Group continues to grow internationally across multiple brands and markets, we've established a global Brand team to strengthen consistency and brand identity across the business. We are now looking for a design leader who can bring the same strategic approach to our digital customer experience.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Product, you will own the global UX and design vision across our brands, products, and customer journeys. You will play a key role in building a scalable design practice, establishing a global design system, and ensuring a seamless user experience across markets while balancing local needs with global consistency. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and Commercial teams, you will drive design excellence, champion user-centred thinking, and help shape how millions of customers interact with our products and brands. You will also help future-proof how we work by leveraging emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and modern SaaS platforms to improve design effectiveness and customer outcomes.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an experienced design professional who is ready to take the next step into a broader, more strategic leadership role, while still enjoying hands-on involvement in design and customer experience
   

  

 Hybrid work model with in-office collaboration Tuesday to Thursday at our Stockholm office on Södermalm, balancing flexibility with strong team connection.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own and evolve the global UX and design vision across Haypp Group's brands and digital products
* Establish and scale a global design system across markets, platforms, and storefronts
* Define design principles, governance models, and ways of working across teams
* Drive user-centred design through research, testing, insights, and performance data
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Brand, and Commercial stakeholders globally
* Ensure consistent and seamless customer experiences across brands, platforms, and markets
* Mentor designers and strengthen design capabilities and maturity across the organization
* Connect design decisions to business outcomes including conversion, retention, and engagement
* Stay at the forefront of emerging design technologies, AI capabilities, and SaaS platforms, helping shape how Haypp leverages new tools, workflows, and ways of working


**What We Are Looking For**
* 6-10 years of experience in Product Design, UX Design, Digital Design, or related fields, including experience leading projects, teams, or design practices
* Proven experience building and scaling design systems across multiple products, brands, or markets
* Experience leading designers through direct people management or senior design leadership
* Strong understanding of UX, interaction design, user research, design operations, and customer journeys
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and Commercial teams
* Strong understanding of modern design ecosystems, including design tools, AI-powered workflows, and SaaS platforms
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution when needed
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills
* Experience from e-commerce, digital consumer products, marketplaces, or similar environments is highly valued
* Fluent in English


**YOU WILL PROBABLY THRIVE HERE IF YOU**
* Enjoy building and scaling design capabilities, frameworks, and teams
* Combine strong design thinking with commercial understanding and business impact
* Enjoy creating clarity, structure, and alignment in growing organizations
* Are curious about emerging technologies and excited by the opportunities AI can create for teams and customers


**What We Offer**
 We are a value-driven company with our values
 **We Team Up, Innovation Drives Us, Inclusion and Non-Hierarchy, and Going the Extra Mile** 
 at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

 At Haypp Group, you can always expect supportive colleagues who want to achieve things together and a culture where everyone's voice matters. We encourage ideas from all parts of the organization and are not afraid to try new things. At the same time, we celebrate achievements and recognize the hard work that goes into reaching them.
   

  

 Because our people are our most important differentiator, we offer generous benefits including:
   

  

* Competitive occupational pension
* Insurance plan, including private healthcare
* 30 days of paid vacation
* Parental pay lift
* Wellness allowance of 5,000 SEK per year
* Regular social activities and team events


**SEND US YOUR APPLICATION TODAY**
 If this sounds like a place where you would want to contribute and grow, we would love to hear from you. Haypp Group is committed to equality and diversity and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or marital status.
   

  

 The Haypp Group is spearheading the global transformation from smoking to healthier product alternatives. With origins in Scandinavia our extensive experience from pioneering markets in smoke free alternatives, as well as being a leader in the e-commerce sector, we now fully bring our vision to a global scale.
   

  

 With 11 e-commerce brands, the Haypp Group is present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 100 000 consumers.

title: Freelance Senior Staff Product Designer
description:
Are you a Senior Product Designer who loves taking new features from initial idea to launch while also making great products even better? A growing women’s health brand is looking for a Senior/Staff Product Designer to join its App Features team on a freelance basis. You’ll be part of an international team of smart and ambitious colleagues working together to push women’s health forward through research, technology, and true care for the end user.
 



 You’ll own the design of new features from early insights and concepts through to polished UI and implementation while also improving the core app experiences users rely on every day. Working side-by-side with another Product Designer and collaborating across Product and Engineering, you’ll navigate complex projects, share ideas, challenge each other, and have a real say in what gets built and why.

**TLDR** 



* Capacity

 : ASAP

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
Bolagsplatsen ägs och drivs av Dream Acquisition Group. Vi driver några av Europas ledande marknadsplatser för företagsaffärer.
 



  





 Vi har närvaro i Sverige och Finland och är påväg in på två nya marknader under Q4 2026.
 



  





 • Över 3 miljoner besökare per år
 



 • Fler än 100 000 registrerade köpare
 



 • Tusentals företagsaffärer varje år
 



  





 Vi är cirka femton personer på fyra marknader, med ett centralt kontor i Stockholm som
 



 servar de lokala verksamheterna. Vi växer snabbt med god lönsamhet, leds av erfarna
 



 entreprenörer och har namnkunniga investerare bakom oss.
 



  





 Vi söker en person som tar helhetsansvar för hela kundupplevelsen. På de lokala sajterna och i
 



 alla touchpoints våra användare möter. Från att någon funderar på att sälja sitt livsverk, till att
 



 annonsen ligger uppe och rätt köpare hör av sig.
 



  





**Vad du gör** 




 Du äger hela användarupplevelsen på alla våra marknader. Säljarflödet,
 



 köparupplevelsen, konverteringen — och mejlen, notiserna och texterna som möter
 



 kunden längs vägen. Du hittar själv var folk fastnar — i data, i samtal med kunder, i
 



 säljteamets vardag — bestämmer vad som är värt att göra något åt, och gör det.
 



  





 Med AI-verktyg, prototypverktyg tar du dina idéer till något som
 



 går att klicka på och testa, i stället för att beskriva dem i ord. Vi har ett utvecklarteam
 



 du jobbar tillsammans med. Men du kan ändra texter, landningssidor, priser och tester direkt,
 



 utan omväg.
 



  





 Du rapporterar till vd, jobbar tätt med vår CTO och sitter nära besluten. Det finns
 



 ingen backlog som serveras, du sätter agendan på dina ytor.
 



  





**Vem du är** 




 • Du är besatt av användarupplevelsen och kan förklara vad användaren försöker
 



 uppnå innan du öppnar designverktyget. Du vet att upplevelsen lika mycket handlar
 



 om vad vi skriver som hur det ser ut.
 



 • Du tänker kommersiellt. Du kopplar produktbeslut till intäkt utan att bli ombedd,
 



 och kan säga nej till bra idéer som inte flyttar något.
 



 • Du bygger själv. Du har tagit egna saker från idé till något som fungerar, inte bara
 



 till wireframes.
 



 • Du har ägt ett utfall och behövt stå för det. Ungefär tre till sex års erfarenhet, men
 



 vi bryr oss mer om vad du gjort än hur länge.
 



 • Du talar och skriver engelska obehindrat. Svenska är en fördel, inget krav.
 



  





 Vi kräver ingen designutbildning och ingen bakgrund från stora produktorganisationer.
 



 Företagsförmedling kan du lära dig på några veckor.
 



  





**Hur vi rekryterar** 




 1 Ett samtal på 30 minuter där vi går igenom något du byggt.
 



 2 Ett betalt case på en arbetsdag, med ett riktigt problem ur någon av våra sajter.
 



 3 Genomgång av caset tillsammans, 90 minuter.
 



 4 Referenser och besked.
 



  





 Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm. Skicka något du byggt och gärna med en rad om vad
 



 du valde bort och varför.

title: Design Intern
description:
Design
   

  

 Internship / Global Electrolux Talent (GET)
   

  

**Job Description**
**Internship Design – HQ Stockholm, Sweden**
**This is an internship for an active student of related Bachelor or Master programs at Swedish and European universities.**
**Start date around 1 February 2027 – duration 6 months – full time**
* Attach your portfolio when submitting your application.


**If you want to help build the home of the future, start your career with us.**
 At Electrolux Group, our vision is to be the home appliance industry leader in consumer satisfaction by delivering outstanding lifetime experiences with solutions that always get better. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver more enjoyable and sustainable living
   

  

**About the role:**
 As a
 **Design Intern** 
 , you will have the opportunity to apply your academic knowledge in a professional environment while developing the technical, creative, and collaborative skills required within our design organization.
   

  

 In this role, you will support the design team in the execution of physical product design projects, contributing to specific workstreams and design details while learning established processes, tools, and standards. The experience is designed to provide broad exposure to the Physical Design function, helping you identify your strengths, accelerate your development, and build a strong foundation for your future career.
   

  

**What You'll Learn**
* Design execution fundamentals – supporting the development of products from concept to implementation while following design guidelines and processes.
* Physical product design principles – understanding how aesthetics, functionality, user needs, sustainability, and manufacturability come together in product development.
* Design tools and methodologies – gaining hands-on experience with industry-standard design tools, visualization techniques, and design workflows.
* Cross-functional collaboration – working with designers, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to support project delivery.
* Attention to detail – contributing to design refinements, documentation, prototypes, presentations, and other deliverables.
* Professional communication and project skills – presenting ideas, receiving feedback, managing tasks, and collaborating in a global environment.


**Who you are:**
* You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Design, MFA Advanced Product Design, or Interaction Design.
* Remain an active student throughout the entire internship period enrolled either in a Bachelor or Master program.
* You are passionate about creating products, services, and experiences that improve everyday life through thoughtful, human-centered design.
* You enjoy transforming insights into concepts, concepts into prototypes, and prototypes into meaningful user experiences.
* You bring curiosity, strong visual communication skills, and a desire to challenge existing solutions with fresh perspectives.


 You will be entrusted with meaningful responsibilities while receiving guidance and support from experienced designers. As you build your competence and confidence, you will gradually take on greater ownership and prepare for the transition toward more independent design work. At this stage of your career, the focus is on learning, developing professional capabilities, and gaining valuable experience in a corporate design environment.
   

  

**Please note that Electrolux Group does not provide visa sponsorship for internships. Candidates must already have the legal right to work in Sweden for the full duration of the internship at the time of application. This may include, for example, EU/EEA citizenship, Swedish permanent residence, or a valid Swedish residence and work permit that does not require employer sponsorship. Electrolux Group does not provide visa or relocation support for internships.**
**Where you’ll be:**
 You will be based in Stockholm, our modern global Headquarter, with 1200+ colleagues on site. We work in a hybrid setup that gives everyone up to 20% flexibility to work remotely, while boosting creativity and collaboration through regular office presence. The work contract is full-time and limited to 6 months, with monthly compensation of 21,000 SEK for Bachelor students and 22,000 SEK for Master students.
   

  

**At Electrolux Group, we believe in learning by doing. This internship gives you hands-on experience, meaningful exposure, and a strong foundation for your future career in Procurement.**
**Learn more on how to apply and how we interview on our career page:** 
 https://career.electroluxgroup.com/global/en/internship

title: Master Thesis Project
description:
**Ready to not just envision the future, but to actively build it? At Umain, we’re shaping the next generation of digital products, and we invite passionate graduate students to join us in crafting groundbreaking solutions that truly make an impact.**
**With our motto "Shape, Ship, Scale," we empower our team to not only envision the future but also play a pivotal role in building it. We're a dynamic team where you can shape the future, ship groundbreaking solutions, and scale your abilities in many different ways. We're on the lookout for passionate graduate students to join us, bringing enthusiasm, creativity, and discovery along with them. Bring your ideas and we’ll make it happen together.**
**What We Offer**
* A chance to work on unique projects that explore and push the boundaries of what's possible
* A fun and supportive work environment where you have the opportunity to develop your skills through unique challenges and fantastic colleagues


**Who You Are**
* You're a graduate student with a passion for innovation and a curiosity for solving problems
* You're eager to learn, grow, and take on new challenges
* You value collaboration, diversity, and the opportunity to make a contribution
* You believe in the power of technology to shape the future


**Why Umain?**
**Learning Framework**
**We believe in nurturing talent, which is why we've established a supportive learning environment. Your growth and development are important to us. With guidance from experienced team members, you will build your skills and gain valuable industry experience.**
**Work-Life Balance**
**At Umain, diversity is our strength. We understand that life doesn't pause when you walk into the office. That's why we've cultivated an environment that supports a healthy work-life balance. We welcome interns from all walks of life, recognizing the richness that different backgrounds bring to our team.**
**Innovations And Learning**
**Technology is always evolving, bringing new challenges and opportunities for collaboration and learning. Collaborating with us, you'll work alongside developers, designers, analysts, testers and more to observe how these challenges are tackled, sharing in the knowledge and growing together.**
**We want to make sure you leave your master’s thesis with practical skills and insights that support the next steps in your career. At the same time, we want your thesis work to create real value, contributing insights and results that make a difference in the projects and challenges our teams work on every day.**
**Are you ready to SHAPE, SHIP, and SCALE with us?**
**If you're a budding graduate student who thrives on innovation, values a supportive and inclusive workplace, and is eager to learn and contribute, we'd love to hear from you. Let's build something awesome together.**
**Umain is a digital product consultancy. We shape, ship and scale digital products at speed. Founded in Stockholm in 2001, we are a growing team of 100+ experts in digital product strategy, design, and technology.**
**We are a part of** 
**Eidra** 
**, a group of top-notch companies specializing in strategy, creativity, and engineering. As a collective we guide leaders in making meaningful and lasting change.**
**Projects**
**We do not offer a list of pre-defined projects. Instead, we encourage you to take an active role in envisioning future digital products. Kindly submit your proposals, ideas or topics and we will assess potential alignments.**
**Suggested Topics**
 Umain’s Work Is To Produce High Quality Digital Products For Our Customers, And The Primary Platforms For This Are Therefore Web And Mobile. But We Work In a Variety Of Fields And Concern Numerous Topics, So Any Thesis Area Concerning The Topics Below Are Of Interest To Us
   

  

* AI-assisted software delivery. How coding agents change team structure, estimation, code review, quality and junior-developer growth.
* Building reliable products on top of LLMs. Evaluation, testing, guardrails, cost and latency, and what "done" means when the behaviour is probabilistic.
* Agentic systems in real business workflows. Where autonomy pays off, where humans need to stay in the loop, and how to design review and trust.
* AI-native UX. Interfaces that go beyond the chat box, such as adaptive, generative or conversational interaction. This includes how users build trust in, and calibrate against, AI output.
* Legacy modernisation. Using AI and better tooling to untangle old systems, migrate incrementally and reduce risk.
* Messy-data pipelines. Turning inconsistent real-world inputs like spreadsheets, PDFs and free text into something products can rely on.
* Regulation and responsible tech. The EU AI Act, Cyber Resilience Act, GDPR and accessibility law (the European Accessibility Act), and how they translate into engineering practice rather than just compliance paperwork.
* Sustainable and efficient software. Measuring and reducing the energy and carbon footprint of apps, cloud workloads and AI usage.
* Cross-platform and on-device development. The trade-offs between native, Flutter, React Native and web. This includes running models on-device for privacy and responsiveness.
* Design systems and design-to-code. Closing the gap between design and implementation, and whether AI can make it reliable.
* Developer experience and platform engineering. What makes consulting teams fast and consistent across many different client contexts.
* Software for connected products. Automotive, IoT and in-vehicle or companion-app experiences, where hardware, cloud and mobile meet.
* Consulting in an AI era. How AI changes the way software gets scoped, sold, priced and delivered, and what clients will expect from a consultancy in the future.


**Past Projects**
**“Does a CQRS architecture improve query performance compared to a traditional CRUD architecture in read-heavy systems?”**
**Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) is an architectural pattern that separates read operations (queries) from write operations (commands) in a software system into separate paths. Using a ticket booking system as the test case, a system with heavy read traffic and occasional spikes in bookings, this project measured how CQRS compares to CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) on speed, capacity, and resource usage.**
**"A comparative study of concurrency in Kotlin: Examination of platform threads, virtual threads, and coroutines"**
**Designed to address the high resource consumption associated with traditional JVM platform threads, Kotlin Coroutines and Project Loom’s Virtual Threads offer modern approaches to concurrency. This study directly compared their performance across I/O-bound and CPU-bound scenarios, assessing key metrics such as memory overhead, CPU consumption, latency, and overall throughput.**
**“How effective are different strategies for reducing hallucinations in RAG systems applied to internal technical documentation, and to what extent can long-context prompting replace or supplement RAG for the same purpose?”**
**This study evaluated methods for minimizing hallucinations in technical documentation systems, analyzing performance metrics such as accuracy, latency, and cost while comparing optimal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) configurations directly with long-context prompting techniques.**
**The Process**
* Following your submission, our team conducts an internal evaluation of all incoming project proposals and concepts.
* Should there be a promising alignment, we will invite you to visit our office to share more about your vision.
* You will be paired with a dedicated supervisor who will collaborate with you to refine and focus your scope.
* Kick off your thesis journey!


**Questions**
**If you have any questions feel free to send them to** 
**student@umain.com**
 Umain is a digital product consultancy. We shape, ship and scale digital products at speed. Founded in Stockholm in 2001, we are a growing team of 100+ experts in digital product strategy, design, and technology.
   

  

 We are a part of Eidra, a group of top-notch companies specializing in strategy, creativity, and engineering. As a collective we guide leaders in making meaningful and lasting change.

title: Senior Game Designer (Multiplayer Gameplay Modes) - Paper.io 2
description:
**About Voodoo**
 Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.
   

  

 Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.
   

  

 You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on
 **Paper.io2** 
 .
   

  

 Role
   

  

**Paper Party** 
 is the multiplayer mode of Paper.io 2. We are looking for a dedicated Game Designer to improve the modes we already have and create new ones from scratch.
   

  

 All modes will keep the Paper universe, camera and controls. Beyond that, there is a lot of creative freedom. You will explore new rules, objectives, win conditions, pacing and team setups to create a broad range of fun and replayable multiplayer experiences.
   

  

**You Will**
* Design and prototype new gameplay modes
* Improve existing Paper Party modes
* Define simple, readable rules for one-finger controls
* Iterate quickly through testing, feedback and playtests
* Balance accessibility, competition, pacing and replayability
* Identify weak ideas early and confidently cut or reshape them
* Work closely with the Paper.io 2 team to turn concepts into playable experiences
* Document your designs clearly
* Fine-tune modes directly in Unity whenever possible


 This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving quickly from an idea to a playable prototype, testing it and improving it.
   

  

 Profile
   

  

* 5+ years of experience in mobile F2P games, designing new games, gameplay modes or prototypes from scratch
* Experience shipping player-facing content, ideally in mobile games
* A strong understanding of multiplayer and competitive gameplay
* A good sense of pacing, clarity and player motivation
* A pragmatic and iterative approach: prototype, test, cut and retry
* The ability to work independently and take full ownership
* Strong English communication and collaboration skills


**Nice to have**
* Strong Unity experience
* Ability to prototype directly in the engine
* Experience with mobile controls, multiplayer or party games
* Experience working on live games or live content
