*As part of your application, you may be presented to clients/partners as part of the recruitment process. If selected for the assignment, you will be employed by us and work either with clients or on internal projects and assignments as part of our consulting business.*

 **Your Profile (Must-have requirements)**  

* Hands-on experience with manual testing of mobile applications in an agile product-development environment.
* Strong exploratory-testing skills and the ability to learn, design tests, and evaluate behavior while interacting with an evolving feature.
* Ability to understand backlog tickets, acceptance criteria, user flows, designs, and technical dependencies.
* Good judgement in selecting test coverage according to risk, change scope, customer impact, and the maturity of the feature.
* Experience identifying, documenting, communicating, and following up defects with software engineers.
* Understanding of mobile-specific considerations such as device and operating-system variation, permissions, connectivity, interruptions, navigation, and application state.
* Strong observational, analytical, and communication skills, with the confidence to question assumptions and clarify expected behavior.
* A collaborative and pragmatic mindset, comfortable testing incomplete feature increments and adapting as implementation details change.
* Hands-on experience creating, maintaining, and troubleshooting mobile app test automation with Appium and pytest, including writing clear and reusable Python test code.

 **Application deadline:** 14-10-2026

 **About Us**

Working at Deploja is something entirely different from working at an ordinary consulting company—and we are really proud of that. So, what makes us unique?  

  

We simply offer more than just a high salary and greater freedom; that’s just the beginning. With us, you’ll find the work environment and opportunities you deserve. Welcome to Deploja, where the grass is indeed greener!

title: Platform Engineer, OpenShift / Kubernetes
description:
We're looking for a platform engineer who loves building the foundation developers work on every day. Kubernetes, CI/CD, security and everything in between. Sometimes in the cloud, often on-prem. You've built and run platforms in production, not just drawn them on a whiteboard. You like using AI tools in your daily work to work faster and smarter.


You definitely don't need to tick every box below. We're looking for someone with experience from a few of these areas, or something similar, and a curiosity to learn the rest. If you're unsure whether you're a match, apply anyway. We'd rather have the conversation.

**WHO ARE YOU?**  

You're a social person who thrives in a team and enjoys collaborating. You like taking responsibility, can lead and structure the work, and help the team stay on course. You're comfortable both shaping the architecture and getting your hands dirty when something needs fixing in production.

**TECH AND SKILLS**  

We think you have experience with a few of these, or something similar:

* Kubernetes or OpenShift
* A cloud platform like AWS, Azure or GCP
* CI/CD tools like GitLab, Jenkins, ArgoCD or Tekton
* Building security into pipelines, secrets management or IAM
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, Ansible or similar
* Running platform services in production

**NICE TO HAVE**  

Bonus if you've come across any of these, but nothing we expect:

* On-prem or air-gapped environments
* Migrating toolchains, for example from Atlassian to GitLab
* Artifactory, Nexus or SonarQube
* Python or Go
* Backstage or Red Hat Developer Hub

**THE ASSIGNMENTS**  

We're a Red Hat partner specialized in developer platforms, and we've helped build platforms at companies like Volvo, IKEA and Länsförsäkringar. You'll work in teams at our clients, helping them build, modernize and run their developer platform. It could be setting up a software factory from scratch, consolidating a scattered toolchain into something maintainable, building security into every step from commit to production, or adding a developer portal on top so teams actually find and use what's there. We always go into assignments as a team, never alone, so you'll both mentor and be mentored.

**EXPERIENCE**  

A few years of working with infrastructure, DevOps or platform engineering. What you've built matters more to us than the exact number of years.

**ABOUT US**  

Logikfabriken is a consultancy by and for talented, engaged and fun people in tech.


Our ambition is to become Sweden's best and most inspiring employer. Together we create the conditions and drive the company forward.


We value spending time together, which is why we go on two conferences a year and organize talks, after-works and lots of other fun things.


On top of that, we believe in fair pay and transparency. That's why everyone at Logikfabriken has the same terms and sets their own salary, pension, parental pay, number of vacation days and other benefits.


Our model is flexible, secure and in most cases means a substantial pay increase. See for yourself what you could earn: Calculate your salary: https://salary.logikfabriken.com/


We also care a lot about sustainability. Logikfabriken has been climate neutral since 2017 and we're constantly working to reduce our footprint. Find our full offer here: Logikfabriken FAQ: https://jobs.logikfabriken.se/posts?tag=FAQ

title: Mgr, Software Engineering
description:
Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world. More than 200,000 businesses, including Google, Uber, PayPal, Visa, Tinder, and many others, rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email. Whether you need to verify users or create omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications help businesses connect with customers reliably and securely at every step of their journey.


At Sinch, we Dream Big, Win Together, Keep it Simple, and Make it Happen. These values are the foundation of how we work.


**DESCRIPTION**

Sinch is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our core API Connectivity team in Malmö, Sweden.


Our Core Platform leadership is currently distributed across multiple broad strategic areas. To ensure the API Connectivity team receives the focused guidance needed to scale, we are introducing this dedicated leadership role. The current team consists of four software engineers and does not include senior individual contributors such as Staff or Principal Engineers. As a result, we are looking for a leader with strong technical and architectural expertise who can provide both people leadership and technical direction.


In this role, you will guide the team as a people manager while serving as the primary source of technical mentorship for engineering standards, architecture decisions, and system design.


Key responsibilities include:


* Provide dedicated people leadership, coaching, and mentorship to a co-located team of four software engineers, fostering career growth and technical development.
* Define and guide the technical strategy and roadmap for the API Gateway that powers Sinch products, ensuring high standards of performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Lead the design, development, and company-wide rollout of a new centralized Event Delivery Platform over the next 6 to 12 months.
* Drive measurable outcomes through team health and performance, successful platform adoption across major product lines including SMS, Voice, Conversation API, and Numbers, and the decommissioning of legacy systems within the first year.
Act as the primary technical advocate for the team, building strong partnerships with product managers, designers, and engineering teams to drive alignment and best practices across Sinch.  
* 

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Demonstrated technical leadership experience, typically gained in roles such as Tech Lead, Software Architect, Staff Engineer, or Principal Engineer, with a proven track record designing and operating highly available backend platform services. Previous engineering management experience is beneficial but not required.
* Strong expertise in the Java and Kotlin ecosystem, particularly Spring, as well as modern cloud-native technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, and microservices architectures.
* Deep understanding of software architecture, API gateways, and event-driven distributed systems.
* Experience building and operating critical infrastructure platforms at scale with a strong focus on quality, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of shared services across multiple engineering teams.
* A genuine passion for people management, coaching, and team development. We welcome both experienced Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders seeking to transition into engineering management.
* This role is based in our Malmö office and follows a hybrid working model with 2 to 3 days per week in the office. Candidates must be based locally or willing to commute.
As English is our corporate language, please submit your application in English.  
* 

**OUR HIRING PROCESS**

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our hiring approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate the skills, experience, and qualifications most relevant to the role. We may also use data-driven assessments to support hiring decisions and identify candidates most likely to succeed.


We believe recruitment is a two-way process and encourage candidates to ask questions throughout the journey. If this opportunity is not the right fit, we invite you to explore other career opportunities at www.sinch.com/careers .


No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward, hopefully with us.


**SALARY**

The monthly salary range for this position is SEK 62,000 to SEK 80,000. Compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, experience, and other relevant qualifications.

title: ENERGY & ENVIRONMENT CEPM

As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers trainings and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Experience maintaining ISO 14001 and/or ISO 50001 at the site level, including management reviews, non‑conformity management, and corrective actions. Technical Management System Competence Strong understanding of: Data Center Operational controls Energy Management Systems (ISO 50001) Environmental Management Systems (ISO 14001) Project and Program Delivery Demonstrated capability to identify, scope, and deliver energy performance improvement projects at operating sites Communication and Stakeholder Engagement Experience delivering management system communications and coordinating management review inputs Ability to present to and influence site-level Leadership Team Documentation and Data Management Ability to manage program documentation, maintain records, track non-conformities, and support document control procedures Background Check Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role.
  
  

These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications: Individual Certifications/Accreditations ISO 14001 Awareness Training or ISO 50001 Awareness Training Datacenter Industry Experience Experience working in hyperscale datacenter environments Tools and Systems Proficiency with M365 tool suite, documentation structures, PowerBI or equivalent dashboards, and KPI monitoring tools Program and Change Management Demonstrated ability to support site-level adoption of new management system processes and continuous improvement plans

title: Data Analyst
description:
Vi söker fler konsulter som vill hjälpa våra kunder att skapa affärsvärde genom ett datadrivet arbetssätt där analys, teknik och verksamhetsförståelse möts.


Hos oss arbetar du i en trygg miljö där långsiktighet, kvalitet och samarbete är viktigare än snabba leveranser. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder, i roller där du är med och omsätter data till beslut, insikter och konkreta förbättringar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka både hur organisationer arbetar med data och hur de utvecklar sin datadrivna förmåga över tid.

### **Är du den vi söker?**


Som Data Analyst-konsult hos oss hjälper du våra kunder att förstå sin verksamhet bättre genom data. Du trivs i uppdrag där du får:

* förstå verksamhetens behov på djupet
* identifiera mönster, trender och förbättringsmöjligheter i data
* omsätta komplex information till tydliga insikter och rekommendationer
* bygga rapporter, dashboards och beslutsunderlag
* säkerställa att analyser baseras på tillförlitlig data av hög kvalitet
* arbeta nära både verksamhet, produktteam och tekniska specialister


Du behöver inte vara expert på allt. Vi söker dig som är trygg i din kompetens, nyfiken på helheten och trivs med att ta ansvar i dina uppdrag.

### **Vad du kan arbeta med hos oss**


Rollen kan se olika ut beroende på kund, uppdrag och din profil. Till exempel:

* Explorativ analys och datadriven problemlösning
* Framtagning av KPI:er, nyckeltal och beslutsunderlag
* Visualisering och rapportering i Power BI, Tableau eller liknande verktyg
* Analys av kundbeteenden, affärsprocesser eller digitala tjänster
* Modellering och kvalitetssäkring av data
* Hypotesdriven analys och experimentering
* Analyslösningar i moderna data- och molnplattformar
* AI-stödd analys och arbete med moderna analysverktyg
* Samarbete med data engineers, data scientists, utvecklare och verksamhetsrepresentanter


Du kan arbeta nära verksamheten, tekniken eller röra dig mellan båda världarna. Många av våra konsulter rör sig obehindrat mellan teknik och affär.

### **Vem vi tror att du är**


Du är en person som:

* gillar att samarbeta och skapa förtroende hos kunder och kollegor
* är nyfiken på data, teknik och nya arbetssätt
* drivs av att lösa problem och skapa värde genom insikter
* har ett strukturerat och datadrivet arbetssätt
* värderar kvalitet och långsiktighet
* är prestigelös och trivs i team
* vill dela med dig av din kunskap och lära av andra
* kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt


Vi tror på olika erfarenheter och perspektiv, och på att du utvecklas bäst i en miljö där du får vara dig själv.

### **Vi ser att du har**

* minst tre års erfarenhet som Data Analyst eller i en liknande analytisk roll
* erfarenhet av att omvandla data till affärsmässiga insikter och rekommendationer
* goda kunskaper i SQL och Python
* erfarenhet av visualisering och rapportering i Power BI, Tableau eller liknande verktyg
* erfarenhet av någon eller några moderna data- och analysplattformar, exempelvis Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Airflow, Jupyter Notebooks, Azure ML eller SageMaker
* förståelse för datamodellering, datakvalitet och datadrivna arbetssätt
* förståelse för AI och moderna analysverktyg och ser det som en naturlig del av analysarbetet
* förmåga att kommunicera insikter och rekommendationer på ett tydligt sätt


Det är starkt meriterande om du har erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud samt har arbetat med AI/ML-verktyg, experimentdriven analys eller produkt- och kundanalys.

### **Uppdrag med kvalitet, förtroende och långsiktighet**


Vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när det finns tid att förstå verksamheten på djupet. Därför arbetar vi ofta i långsiktiga uppdrag där våra kunder ser oss som en strategisk partner snarare än en tillfällig resurs.


Som Data Analyst hos oss får du arbeta med analys i miljöer där data är affärskritiskt och där krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och tillförlitlighet är höga. Samtidigt har du alltid nära till kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap och stöttar dig i din utveckling.

### **Vi satsar på dig**


Omegapoint är byggt för lärande. Här får du:

* gemenskap, kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och kunskapsdelning
* möjlighet att föreläsa, certifiera dig och leda initiativ
* en kultur där vi är både vassa och snälla
* kollegor som gärna delar med sig, stöttar och inspirerar


Tillsammans bygger vi säkra digitala lösningar som skapar långsiktigt värde.

### **Om oss**


Omegapoint är norra Europas ledande konsultbolag inom säker digital innovation. Vi är över 800 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Örebro, Västerås, Enköping, Uppsala och Umeå.

title: Mechanical Technician, Data Center Community
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


What you'll do  

  

Plan and deliver maintenance  

Plan, sequence and deliver preventive maintenance across all your assigned data center sites.  

Carry out hands-on maintenance, including filter changes, tank inspections, legionella testing, pump servicing, UV lamp replacement and fuel system checks.  

Keep maintenance reports and planners accurate and up to date.  

  

Troubleshoot and fix for good  

Act as the first responder for mechanical faults and carry out first-level troubleshooting to restore service quickly and safely.  

Lead root cause analysis on failures and make sure remediation is completed so issues don't come back.  

Prioritize tasks and manage work through ticketing systems so critical issues are handled first.  

  

Own your assets and spares  

Enter and manage asset, work order and maintenance history data in the EAM system for your assigned equipment.  

Identify, buy and store the spares and parts needed for planned and reactive work, so downtime is never caused by a missing part.  

  

Lead safely and raise the bar  

Write and apply risk assessments and method statements (RAMS) for all your work  

Supervise contractors who do servicing and preventive maintenance and hold them to Amazon's safety and quality standards.  

Mentor on-site Engineering Operations Technicians so they can respond confidently to mechanical events  

Look for ways to cut energy and operating costs without lowering reliability, and own your ideas from start to finish.  

  

\*How you'll work\*  

You'll normally work Monday to Friday during standard office hours. You'll also join an on-call rotation and work outside hours when operations need it. You'll travel regularly between data center sites in the cluster.  

  

\*Who you'll work with\*  

You'll join a diverse team of operations engineers, supply chain specialists, mechanical field engineers and site construction. Together you'll deliver the highest availability at the lowest possible cost. Our culture is inclusive: we value curiosity, ownership and the drive to keep raising the bar.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

What you'll do  

Equipment reliability: Operate and maintain all of the equipment above across your assigned data centers, so every system is ready when it's needed.  

Preventive maintenance: Plan, coordinate and carry out scheduled maintenance, including filter changes, belt and bearing checks, pump and fan inspections, UV lamp replacement, water quality checks and fuel system testing, so issues are caught before they reach customers.  

Troubleshooting and root cause: Diagnose electrical, mechanical and controls faults hands-on, find the true root cause and deliver lasting fixes, not just workarounds.  

Reactive response: Respond quickly and safely to equipment failures and alarms, and restore service with minimal impact.  

Water and fuel readiness: Keep water tanks and UV treatment systems hygienic and compliant, and keep fuel systems clean, full and ready for generator backup at any moment.  

Cost and innovation: Look for ways to cut energy and operating costs without lowering reliability. Bold ideas are welcome, and you'll own them from start to finish.  

Safety and compliance: Meet the highest safety, environmental and regulatory standards on every task, especially when working with fuel, pressurized water systems and at height on rooftop equipment.  

  

A day in the life  

Most of your time goes to hands-on work, such as replacing AHU filters, inspecting a water tank, running a legionella test or servicing a pump, all under the risk assessments and method statements you've written. Some days you might travel to another site to supervise a contractor's maintenance visit, help site operations team through an unfamiliar AHU fault, or dig into the root cause of last week's failure. Before you finish, you update EAM and send your operational assessment to the Chief Engineers. No two days are the same, but each one adds to the 99.999% uptime that AWS customers rely on.  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of relevant work experience within the mechanical equipment field. (Pumps, engines, cooling systems etc)
* Ability to travel between all nominated sites on a daily or weekly basis.
* EU Drivers license.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Particular experience in cooling systems (AHUs, CRAHUs, HVAC systems, Generators, Pumps, industrial water systems) is advantageous.
* Demonstrated capability in understanding and troubleshooting of cooling equipment and fundamentals.
* Training or certification in cooling systems a strong benefit.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Digital Workplace Services Senior Engineer
description:
Join a team where you will shape and support modern Digital Workplace services across the full Microsoft ecosystem, from Microsoft 365 and Intune to Identity, Security, and emerging AI capabilities. As a senior technical expert, you will have the opportunity to solve complex customer challenges, influence service innovation, and help organizations get the most from their Microsoft investments.

* Shape the future of Digital Workplace services by driving innovation, automation, security, and AI-powered solutions across the full Microsoft Modern Workplace ecosystem.
* Act as a senior technical authority and trusted advisor, solving complex challenges and helping customers maximize the value of their Microsoft investments.
* Work in a collaborative, international team where knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and technical excellence are at the heart of everything we do.


The Microsoft Cloud Services team brings together deep technical expertise across Microsoft technologies while fostering a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. Team members work closely across multiple countries, supporting each other on complex customer challenges and continuously learning from one another. Led by Heidi Storm, the team values transparency, accountability, continuous development, and delivering meaningful outcomes for customers.  

  

My name is Heidi Storm. I am the Head of Microsoft Cloud Services. As a leader, I believe in creating an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and empowered to do their best work. I value transparency, collaboration, and continuous learning, and I enjoy helping individuals grow their expertise while working together to solve complex challenges and deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers.

**Your role & influence as Digital Workplace Services Senior Engineer**

*Responsibility*: You will be given responsibility for designing, operating, and continuously improving Microsoft Digital Workplace services across Microsoft 365, Security, Identity, and Endpoint Management, ensuring high service quality, operational excellence, and customer success.

 *Collaboration*: Together with your team, you take care of designing, operating, and continuously improving Microsoft 365, Security, Identity, and Endpoint Management services. You'll work closely not only with your immediate team members but also with the Service Desk and Customer Success teams to deliver reliable, secure, and value-driven solutions for customers.  

  

*Core activities:*

* Deliver and support Microsoft Cloud services, managing incidents, service requests, troubleshooting, and escalations across Microsoft 365, Identity, Security, and Endpoint Management environments.
* Drive service quality and continuous improvement by optimizing configurations, maintaining documentation, sharing knowledge, and identifying opportunities for automation and standardization.
* Act as a senior technical expert and trusted advisor, collaborating with internal teams and customers to implement secure, scalable, and value-driven Digital Workplace solutions.

**Benefits of joining Dustin**


We believe there's more to Dustin than just the benefits listed here. You'll fully understand this once you're with us. Curious? Our Life at Dustin page has you covered.

**You can find more of our benefits below in the vacancy.**

**This is what we imagine you bring**


We envision you as a curious and driven individual who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for solving complex customer challenges, improving services, and staying at the forefront of Microsoft cloud technologies.


Additionally, it's important that:

* You have a bachelor's degree level of working and thinking.
* You have experience designing, administering, and supporting Microsoft 365, Security, Identity, and Endpoint Management services in a customer-focused environment.
* You possess strong technical skills within Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Conditional Access, PIM, Microsoft Defender, and Identity Governance. Nice to have experience includes PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and automation initiatives.
* Swedish and English fluency.

**What can you expect next?**


To ensure a fair recruitment process free from unconscious bias, we handle your application anonymously and do not accept cover letters. Please refrain from sending one, so that the selection is based solely on professional competencies. We expect the following steps in the recruitment process:

* Telephone screening.
* 1st interview with Heidi Storm, hiring manager, and/or colleague.
* Assessment (Personality- and cognitive thinking test).
* 2nd interview with hiring manager and/or colleague.
* Background check.


For questions about the position, please contact the Heidi Storm, hiring manager, via e-mail: heidi.storm@dustin.com

title: Senior Data & AI Engineer till Spendrups
description:
*Vill du vara med och forma nästa generations data- och AI-förmåga i ett av Sveriges mest välkända familjeföretag? Hos Spendrups byggs en modern dataplattform från grunden och tar klivet direkt in i framtidens tillämpade AI.* 




  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Spendrups är ett stolt familjeföretag i fjärde generationen där traditon möter ständig innovation. Med cirka 1 100 medarbetare på bryggerier i Grängesberg, Hällefors och Visby, samt kontor och terminaler runt om i Sverige, är de en av landets ledande dryckesproducenter.
 



  





 Spendrups AI-landskap är just nu under uppbyggnad, vilket ger dig en unik möjlighet att vara med från ett tidigt skede och påverka arkitektur, tekniska vägval, arbetssätt och hur de omsätter AI till konkret verksamhetsnytta för allt från logistik och sälj till produktion.
 



  





 Som Senior Data & AI Engineer får du en nyckelroll i att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till robusta, säkra och skalbara lösningar. Du blir en del av ett mindre, tvärfunktionellt team med stort mandat att driva utvecklingen framåt. Hos Spendrups arbetar du genom hela livscykeln: ena dagen utvecklar du en datapipeline eller datamodell i Microsoft Fabric och dbt, nästa dag bygger du en AI-agent, en MCP-lösning eller en integration som låter en språkmodell använda verksamhetsdata på ett kontrollerat sätt.
 



  





 Spendrups arbetar iterativt och produktnära: identifierar rätt problem, testar hypoteser snabbt och realiserar det som ger effekt. Du kombinerar hands-on utveckling med tekniskt ledarskap och hjälper Spendrups etablera moderna arbetssätt för AI engineering - med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet, kostnadsuppföljning och faktisk nytta.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 



* Dataplattform & Pipelines: Designa och utveckla datapipelines, datamodeller och plattformskapabiliteter i Microsoft Fabric och dbt.
* Tillämpad AI i produktion: Utveckla och produktionssätta AI-lösningar, såsom AI-agenter, RAG-arkitekturer, semantisk sökning och intelligenta arbetsflöden.
* System- & Modellintegration: Integrera språkmodeller med verksamhetsdata, API:er och verktyg i Azure och Microsoft Foundry.
* Kvalitetssäkring & Evals: Etablera tester och utvärderingar (evals, observability, guardrails) som mäter kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och kostnad i våra lösningar.
* Verksamhetsnära utveckling: Arbeta nära verksamheten för att identifiera use-cases, bygga prototyper och omsätta dem till skalbara lösningar.
* Tekniskt ledarskap: Bidra till teknisk riktning, kodgranskning, CI/CD, dokumentation och gemensamma engineering-principer.



  





**Vi söker dig som har** 



* Flera års erfarenhet inom Data Engineering, samt att du under senare tid arbetat med eller skiftat fokus mot AI Engineering.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL med erfarenhet av att skriva testbar, produktionsredo kod.
* Erfarenhet av Azure (eller liknande molnmiljöer), moderna dataplattformar, ETL/ELT-flöden samt datamodellering.
* Praktisk förståelse för generativ AI och språkmodeller (exempelvis RAG, embeddings, vektorsökning eller AI-agenter).
* Erfarenhet av API-integrationer, Git, CI/CD och automatisering.
* Förmåga att bedöma tekniska lösningar utifrån skalbarhet, säkerhet och mätbar verksamhetsnytta.



  





**Det är meriterande om du har** 



* Erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry eller Azure AI-tjänster.
* Hands-on erfarenhet av dbt för strukturerad datamodellering.
* Kunskap om agentiska arbetsflöden, prompt/context engineering, guardrails och utvärderingsramverk (evals).
* Erfarenhet av vektordatabaser och arbete med ostrukturerad data.
* Erfarenhet av MLOps/LLMOps, data governance och Power BI.



  





**Personliga egenskaper** 




 Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett starkt engineering-mindset med nyfikenhet på hur AI kan förändra arbetssätt och beslut. Du tycker om att gå från ett otydligt verksamhetsproblem till en fungerande lösning, men förstår också att verkligt värde uppstår först när lösningen är säker, mätbar, förvaltbar och används i vardagen. Du tar initiativ, experimenterar pragmatiskt och delar öppet med dig av lärdomar. Samtidigt är du trygg i att välja bort teknik som inte löser rätt problem och i att balansera innovation med kvalitet, ansvar och långsiktighet.
 



  





**Vår rekryteringsprocess** 




 Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Solutions Architect - Nordics
description:
**Who are we?**
 Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
   

  

 We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
   

  

 We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
   

  

 We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
   

  

**Why this role?**
 In this role as a founding Solutions Architect for Cohere in the Nordics, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s business in both the Nordics territory and the wider European region. You will partner with account executives, partners, and our executive leadership team to communicate and demonstrate the value of our technology to the market, and build on the success of our flagship customers, like Saab, TKMS and Thales.
   

  

 SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits:
   

  

* Technical experts in the field
* Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues
* Product evangelists of Cohere technology
* Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI


 Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products.
   

  

 In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers.
   

  

 As the technical relationship owner, you will collaborate with stakeholders to understand their business objectives and translate those into our technical solutions. You will take ownership of the customer narrative, serving as the voice of the customer and acting as a liaison between the customer and our product team. Additionally, you will provide guidance on best practices for using Cohere, identify areas for improvement within the platform, and cultivate technical champions within customer organizations to drive adoption and gather feedback to enhance our products.
   

  

**A Typical Day At Cohere Might Include**
* Leading the technical talk track on customer calls.
* Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments.
* Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology.
* Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots.
* Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere.
* Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs.
* Working closely with our partners to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers.


**This might be for you if you have some of the following:**
* 3+ years of customer-facing technical pre/post sales Solutions Architect/Solutions Engineer/Sales Engineer/Digital Strategy Consultant (or similar) experience.
* A passion for Generative AI, and an understanding of strengths and weaknesses of Generative LLMs and AI technologies.
* Familiarity with foundational ML concepts (training, evaluation, etc.)
* Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences.
* Thrives within ambiguous and uncharted environments
* You can identify and implement high-impact processes in unstructured environments.
* Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools
* Preferred: 2+ years architecting, deploying or consulting on NLP/AI/LLM Solutions
* Preferred: Fluency in Swedish, Danish or Norwegian
* Must have: Professional fluency in English (business and technical)


*Please note: for this role we are open to a range of experience levels, from Associate to Staff-level Individual Contributors (ICs). Experience level stated is a bare minimum.*
**Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks**
* A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
* Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
* RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
* 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
* Annual enrichment benefits:


 Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   

  

 Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.
   

  

* 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
* Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.


**How And Where We Work**
* Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
* For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
* For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
* Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.


 If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.
   

  

 We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.
   

  

 We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.
   

  

*Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our* 
*official careers* 
*page.*

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Public Sector
description:
Vill du vara med och driva utvecklingen mot ett mer suveränt, säkert och europeiskt digitalt landskap?
 



 Cleura söker nu en Enterprise Account Executive, Public Sector
 



 en kommersiellt driven och relationsorienterad affärsutvecklare som vill ta ansvar för att identifiera, utveckla och vinna nya affärer inom svensk offentlig sektor.

**Om rollen** 




 Som Enterprise Account Executive, Public Sector
 



 får du ett tydligt kommersiellt ansvar för att utveckla Cleuras position och nykundsaffär inom svensk offentlig sektor.
 



 Du kommer att arbeta med kommuner, regioner och myndigheter samt med det ekosystem av partners och leverantörer som påverkar hur offentlig IT utvecklas och upphandlas.
 



 Din uppgift blir inte enbart att bearbeta befintliga leads. Du ska skapa marknad, bygga relationer, identifiera affärsmöjligheter och driva komplexa affärer från första kontakt till vunnen affär.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* Identifiera och bearbeta nya strategiska kunder inom kommun, region och stat
* Bygga långsiktiga relationer med CIO:er, IT-chefer, digitaliseringsansvariga, verksamhetsansvariga och andra relevanta beslutsfattare
* Identifiera behov och affärsmöjligheter innan de blir formella upphandlingar
* Driva komplexa och längre säljprocesser med flera beslutsfattare och intressenter
* Navigera i offentlig upphandling och förstå hur ramavtal, avrop och upphandlingsstrategier påverkar affären
* Utveckla Cleuras position hos strategiska kunder och skapa en tydlig pipeline
* Arbeta nära Cleuras tekniska och kommersiella organisation för att utveckla rätt kundlösningar
* Identifiera och utveckla affärer tillsammans med systemintegratörer, MSP:er, SaaS-bolag och andra strategiska partners
* Bygga och utveckla relationer inom det offentliga IT-ekosystemet
* Delta i kunddialoger, workshops och strategiska möten på både affärsmässig och teknisk nivå
* Ansvara för hela den kommersiella processen från prospektering till avtal
* 



**Vi söker dig som kan offentlig sektor på riktigt** 




 Vi söker dig som redan har erfarenhet av att göra affärer med offentlig sektor och förstår hur marknaden fungerar.
 



 Du har sannolikt:
 


* Minst 7–10 års relevant erfarenhet av försäljning mot offentlig sektor
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av affärer med kommuner, regioner och/eller statliga myndigheter
* Ett etablerat nätverk inom svensk offentlig sektor
* God förståelse för offentlig upphandling, LOU, ramavtal och avropsmodeller
* Erfarenhet av längre och komplexa säljcykler
* Erfarenhet av att sälja IT, molntjänster, infrastruktur, cybersäkerhet, managed services eller närliggande tjänster
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med större organisationer och flera beslutsnivåer
* Förmåga att förstå både kundens verksamhetsbehov och den underliggande IT-infrastrukturen
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med partners och ekosystem, exempelvis systemintegratörer, konsultbolag eller andra teknikleverantörer



  





*Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av cloud, IaaS/PaaS, cybersäkerhet, dataskydd, digital suveränitet eller verksamhetskritisk IT.* 




  





 Du är en Hunter, men du förstår att stora affärer byggs över tid
 



 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara genuint nykundsorienterad
 



 Du trivs med att öppna dörrar som inte redan står öppna. Du är uthållig och strukturerad och kan arbeta med en affär långt innan det finns en konkret upphandling.
 



 Du vet samtidigt när det är dags att vara kommersiellt offensiv och när det är viktigare att bygga förtroende och position.
 



 Du är bekväm med att själv driva dina affärer men förstår också värdet av att skapa rätt team runt kunden.
 



 Du behöver därför kunna växla mellan:
 



**Hunter → Relationsbyggare → Affärsutvecklare → Förhandlare → Partner** 




**Du förstår det offentliga ekosystemet** 




  





  





**Personliga egenskaper** 




 Vi tror att du är:
 


* Kommersiell och resultatorienterad
* Nyfiken och affärsmässigt driven
* Relationsskapande på senior nivå
* Uthållig och strukturerad
* Självgående med starkt eget driv
* Trovärdig i dialog med seniora beslutsfattare
* Prestigelös och bra på att samarbeta
* Intresserad av teknik och samhällsutveckling
* Trygg i komplexa affärer där vägen till avslut kan vara lång



  





 Framför allt har du
 **energin och erfarenheten att öppna nya dörrar inom offentlig sektor och förvandla relationer och marknadsinsikter till konkret affär** 
 .
 



  





**Placering** 




 Rollen är i första hand placerad i
 **Stockholm/Solna** 
 , men vi är öppna för dialog kring annan placering för rätt person.
 



 För den här rollen är närvaro och tillgänglighet i det svenska offentliga ekosystemet viktigare än exakt geografisk placering.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar löpande urval, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
 



  





 Låter det här som en roll för dig? Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Du kan ansöka till tjänsten fram till
 **1 november 2026** 
 .
 



  





 Redo att ta nästa steg? Klicka då på knappen
 **"Ansök till tjänsten"** 
 nedan för att skicka in din ansökan.
 



  





**Varför Cleura – varför nu?** 




 Offentlig sektor står inför en förändrad syn på moln, säkerhet och digital infrastruktur. Kraven på kontroll, regelefterlevnad och digital suveränitet ökar samtidigt som verksamheterna behöver fortsätta digitalisera och accelerera innovation.
 



 Cleura befinner sig mitt i denna förändring.
 



 Som Enterprise Account Executive, Public Sector
 



 får du möjligheten att vara med och bygga Cleuras nästa fas inom offentlig sektor – och samtidigt bidra till utvecklingen av ett mer europeiskt och suveränt digitalt landskap.

title: Senior Channel Sales Manager
description:
Vill du bygga starka partnerrelationer, skapa affärstillväxt och vara en viktig länk mellan kunder, partners och interna team? Då kan rollen som Channel Sales Manager på Cleura vara nästa steg för dig.
 



  





 Som Channel Sales Manager ansvarar du för att utveckla och stärka relationerna med våra Channel Partners och tillsammans skapa långsiktig och lönsam tillväxt. Du blir en central kontaktperson för våra partners och arbetar nära både dem och Cleuras interna organisation för att säkerställa att affärsmål, kundbehov och gemensamma planer omsätts i resultat.
 



 Det här är en roll för dig som trivs med stort eget ansvar, har ett kommersiellt driv och motiveras av att skapa framgång tillsammans med andra.
 



  





***Om Cleura***




*Cleura är en europeisk molnleverantör som erbjuder säker, suverän och hållbar molninfrastruktur baserad på open source-teknik, framför allt OpenStack.* 




*Med ett starkt fokus på dataskydd, transparens och digital suveränitet hjälper Cleura organisationer över hela Europa att behålla kontrollen över sina data, samtidigt som de får tillgång till skalbara och högpresterande molnlösningar.* 




*I en tid där kontroll över data, säkerhet och digital infrastruktur blir allt viktigare spelar Cleura en central roll för organisationer som vill kombinera flexibiliteten i molnet med höga krav på säkerhet, integritet och självbestämmande.* 




*Hos Cleura får du möjlighet att vara med och utveckla ett växande europeiskt molnekosystem och skapa långsiktigt värde tillsammans med våra kunder och partners.* 




  





**Din roll** 




 Du ansvarar för ett antal Channel Partner-konton och driver hela relationen framåt – från affärsplanering och onboarding till utveckling av nya affärsmöjligheter och uppföljning av resultat.
 



 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* **Utveckla och vårda långsiktiga relationer** 
 med befintliga Channel Partners och deras kunder samt säkerställa hög partnernöjdhet.
* enom att identifiera, attrahera och etablera nya strategiska Channel Sales Partners i utvalda europeiska marknader.
* **Identifiera och driva nya affärsmöjligheter** 
 , utveckla befintliga partnerskap och säkerställa att affärer drivs framåt och stängs i tid.
* **Planera och följa upp gemensamma affärsmål** 
 tillsammans med partners, inklusive försäljning, prognoser, intäkter och relevanta KPI.
* **Vara en central länk mellan partners och Cleuras interna team** 
 och säkerställa tydlig kommunikation, effektiv samverkan och framdrift.
* **Följa marknads- och konkurrensutvecklingen** 
 och bidra till Cleuras fortsatta tillväxt genom att strategiskt utveckla vårt partnernätverk och kundengagemang i Europa.



  





 I rollen följer vi bland annat utvecklingen inom:
 


* Antal och kvalitet på partnerinteraktioner.
* Channel Partner-nöjdhet.
* Partnerdriven omsättning och Customer Lifetime Value (LTV).
* Onboarding och time-to-value, exempelvis
 **Time-to-1st-Use (TT1U)** 
 och
 **Time-to-Production (TTP)** 
 .
* Utvecklingen av affärsmöjligheter och uppnådda affärsmål.
* Kvaliteten och aktualiteten i account-dokumentation och business planning.



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Vi söker dig som är relationsskapande, affärsdriven och trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt tänkande med operativt genomförande.
 



 Du är van vid att ta eget ansvar och driva processer framåt, samtidigt som du samarbetar nära både externa partners och interna team. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt, är kommunikativ och har förmågan att skapa förtroende på olika nivåer i en organisation.
 



 Som person har du en
 **optimistisk och energisk approach** 
 och tycker om att hitta lösningar, skapa möjligheter och bygga relationer som håller över tid.
 



  





 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
 


* Channel Sales, Partner Sales eller Account Management.
* Att utveckla och driva strategiska partnerrelationer.
* Business planning, forecasting och pipeline management.
* B2B-försäljning inom IT, cloud eller tech.
* Att arbeta tvärfunktionellt med exempelvis Sales, Customer Success, Operations och andra interna team.



  





  





**Placering** 




  





 Rollen är i första hand placerad i
 **Stockholm/Solna** 
 , men vi är öppna för dialog kring annan placering för rätt person.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar löpande urval, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

 **30 november 2026** 
 .

title: Principal - Stockholm | BCG Platinion
description:
Who We Are
   

  

**Shape the technology agenda of leading companies**
 AI and digital technology are fundamentally redefining industries, business models and competitive advantage. At BCG Platinion, we work with ambitious leaders to turn that disruption into transformative business impact.
   

  

 As part of Boston Consulting Group (BCG), we combine deep technology expertise with BCG's strategy, industry and transformation capabilities. We work at the intersection of AI, digital, technology and business, helping clients move from ambition to execution and from experimentation to impact at scale.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape how leading global companies use technology and AI to compete and transform? Join BCG Platinion in tackling their most consequential technology challenges as a Principal in Stockholm!
   

  

 Shape executive technology agendas, originate transformational opportunities, and lead complex digital and AI programs that help our clients capture the potential of technology. Work at the intersection of business and technology, combining executive advisory, commercial leadership, and broad technical expertise across generative and agentic AI, cloud, data, software, modern architectures, and digital platforms. Add your individual strengths to our unique team, always there to support you. Together with our colleagues at Boston Consulting Group and our clients, we turn digital visions into reality.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 We are looking for Principals who will shape client agendas and lead multidisciplinary teams from BCG Platinion and Boston Consulting Group on local and international client engagements!
   

  

**At BCG Platinion, You Will**
* Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CEOs, and other senior executives, shaping their technology and transformation agendas and helping them make consequential strategic, investment, and operating-model decisions
* Originate, shape, and win substantial opportunities across AI, digital, technology modernization, and enterprise transformation, turning emerging client challenges into compelling propositions and transformational programs
* Shape enterprise AI and GenAI transformations, helping clients move from experimentation to scaled business impact through clear value priorities, fit-for-purpose platforms and architectures, strong data foundations, governance, responsible AI, and new ways of working
* Architect and oversee large, complex transformation programs spanning strategy, technology, organization, operating model, and implementation, navigating complex stakeholder environments and ensuring alignment, quality, and impact
* Orchestrate multidisciplinary capabilities across BCG Platinion, BCG's industry and functional practices, BCG X, and other specialists, while providing senior leadership and quality assurance across multiple engagements and client relationships
* Develop outstanding Managers, Consultants, Architects, and technical leaders, and contribute to the growth and strategic direction of BCG Platinion through recruiting, intellectual capital, propositions, and market presence


 What You'll Bring
   

  

**You can help us make a difference if you**
* Have at least eight to ten years of substantial experience in IT consulting or digital transformation, including shaping and leading complex strategy and implementation programs
* Have a degree in computer science, informatics, engineering, business with a focus on technology, or another relevant field, or bring equivalent relevant industry experience
* Have a strong track record of originating, shaping, and winning substantial consulting engagements and growing senior client relationships
* Have extensive experience advising C-suite executives on complex technology, AI, investment, and transformation decisions
* Have demonstrated ability to architect and oversee large, multidisciplinary programs, mobilize senior teams, and assure quality across multiple engagements
* Have a deep understanding of how technology creates business value, supported by strong knowledge of modern architectures, cloud, data, software, digital platforms, and technology operating models
* Bring practical experience shaping enterprise AI and GenAI transformations, including prioritizing value pools and use-case portfolios, defining scalable data and platform foundations, and addressing agentic AI, governance, and responsible AI
* Can connect technology choices with business strategy, economics, operating models, organizational change, and industry dynamics and translate them into clear investment priorities and business cases
* Bring strong commercial judgment and the ability to recognize and shape opportunities before they become formal client requests
* Have a track record of developing high-performing Managers, Consultants, Architects, and senior technical talent
* Are excellent at understanding and communicating complex topics in English


 Additional info
   

  

**Who You'll Work With**
 You will work with C-suite executives and senior technology leaders as part of interdisciplinary BCG and BCG Platinion teams combining business, industry, technology, data, and AI expertise. As a Principal, you will shape a portfolio of client relationships and major programs, orchestrating capabilities across BCG Platinion, BCG's industry and functional practices, BCG X, and other specialists. Depending on the client agenda, you may define an enterprise AI transformation, shape a technology modernization program, establish a new digital operating model, or guide a large-scale transformation from strategic ambition to sustained impact.
   

  

 Beyond individual engagements, you will help shape the market and strategic direction of BCG Platinion by creating new opportunities, developing propositions and intellectual capital, strengthening senior client relationships, and growing the next generation of leaders.
   

  

**How To Grow With Us**
 We guarantee constant development incentives in an open and rewarding work environment! Together with a dedicated team of talented colleagues, you get to work on new challenges every day. We provide individual training offers, and a culture of open feedback as the underlying framework for you to explore and perfect personal strengths. Our modern structures allow you to focus on the essence of our work – with easy travel booking, excellent back-office support, and a comprehensive Knowledge Center. With our regular office Fridays and legendary events, we nurture a strong and close team network beyond our case work.
   

  

*#BCGPlatinion*
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

title: Senior Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.
   

  

 We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a
 **Senior Fullstack AI Engineer** 
 in our
 **Stockholm** 
 office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?
   

  

**The Role**
 You’ll join a small, multidisciplinary team building products that create value for our users and business. Working closely with product, design and engineering colleagues, you’ll turn agreed opportunities into working products and validate them with users.
   

  

 AI will be a core part of how you build and deliver from development through testing and validation. You’ll help improve these ways of working and share what works with the wider organisation.
   

  

 You’ll bring hands-on experience across frontend and backend development, with deeper expertise in one or both. You’ll build the services and experiences needed to deliver complete products, contributing beyond your main specialism and taking responsibility for how the software performs in production.
   

  

 The team starts with a lab approach: focused scope, short feedback loops, and room to experiment. As we learn what works, the aim is to evolve into an established structure with ongoing product responsibilities. You’ll help shape that journey and take care of the products as they develop.
   

  

**What Your Day Might Look Like**
* Turn agreed product scope into working products and testable releases
* Design, build, and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations
* Build frontend experiences that connect those services to users
* Apply and improve advanced AI-assisted workflows across development, testing, and validation
* Integrate AI capabilities where they add value to the product
* Work with product and design to use data, user insights, and hypotheses to guide implementation and validate outcomes
* Improve performance, reliability, and maintainability as products develop
* Contribute to deployment, maintenance, and operation, taking responsibility for the software you deliver


**What We’re Looking For**
 You’ve used AI across substantial parts of product delivery, beyond individual coding suggestions. You can explain your contribution, how you verified the result, and what you learned.
   

  

**For This Role, We’re Looking For**
* Technical depth: Strong engineering expertise in frontend or backend development, or both. You can make architecture trade-offs and deliver reliable software using automated testing, debugging, and production monitoring
* Practical width: Hands-on experience across frontend development with React or a comparable framework and backend development with Node.js and JavaScript/TypeScript, including APIs, integrations and data handling, enabling you to deliver complete products across the stack
* AI-native delivery: Experience using advanced workflows, such as agent-based or spec-driven development. You can structure work for AI, provide context, evaluate the resulting software, and take responsibility for what reaches production
* Product experience: Work in a product organisation and a cross-functional product team with product managers and designers. You use data and user insights to test hypotheses, validate value, and take shared responsibility for outcomes after release


**It’s a bonus if you have:** 
  

  

* Experience building backend services or systems in Rust and/or Python
* Experience with AWS and distributed, event-driven or serverless systems
* Experience with automated delivery pipelines and infrastructure as code
* Experience with mobile development or other technologies that broaden your contribution
* Experience with experimentation tooling and optimising toward user experience metrics
* Experience with integration of AI/ML products and incorporating user feedback signals as feedback


 You bring approaches we can learn from and can demonstrate where AI has improved your delivery, as well as where it has required more care. You are comfortable challenging existing practices and helping the team test better ones.
   

  

 We value curiosity, ownership and colleagues who are generous with their knowledge and help others succeed.
   

  

 What's in it for you
   

  

 An opportunity to help shape how Viaplay builds products with AI. You’ll work closely with colleagues across disciplines, contribute across the stack, and see how your work influences both the products we deliver and the way the team develops.
   

  

 You’ll join at a stage where there is room to experiment and help establish practices that can benefit the wider organisation.
   

  

 What we offer you
   

  

* We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
* A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
* An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
* Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.


**Hit play today**
 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Channel Account Manager (Swedish Speaking)
description:
*ConnectWise is an industry and Global leading software company with over 3,000 colleagues in North America, EMEA and APAC. As a community-driven software company dedicated to the success of technology solution providers, our suite helps over 45,000 of our partners manage their businesses better, sell more efficiently, automate service delivery, and remotely control technology so they can consistently deliver amazing customer experiences.* 




*Our company is powered by our connections, our colleagues, and our community. And, we accept all kinds.* 




*Game-changers, innovators, culture-lovers—and humankind.* 




*We invite discovery and debate. We recognize key moments as milestones.* 




*We see you and value you for your unique contributions. Our inclusive, positive culture lays the foundation to ensure every colleague is valued for their perspectives and skills, giving you the choice of how YOU make a difference.* 




**Curious? Read this opportunity to learn how YOU can make a difference at ConnectWise!** 




  





**General Summary:** 




 The Channel Account Manager – Nordics is responsible for driving growth, retention, and expansion across an established base of Nordic Managed Service Provider (MSP) partners. This role operates within a distributor‑aligned partner model, working closely with existing Nordic partners that are contractually and operationally aligned to regional distributors.
 



 The RSM acts as the primary commercial owner for these partners and works collaboratively with distributors, internal sales, marketing, and product teams. Knowledge and hands‑on experience within the Nordic MSP channel is highly recommended, as success in this role depends on understanding local market dynamics, partner business models, and indirect sales execution.
 



  





**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:** 



* Manage a defined portfolio of existing Nordic MSP partners as the primary commercial point of contact.
* Operate effectively within a sell‑to and sell‑through partner sales model, in close alignment with Nordic distributors.
* Build and maintain long‑term partner relationships to drive retention, expansion, and partner health.
* Act as an escalation point for commercial matters and coordinate internal resources to support partner success.
* Achieve personal annual sales targets based on total contract value.
* Drive growth through upsell and cross‑sell motions within the existing partner base.
* Manage the full sales cycle from opportunity qualification to close, in line with ConnectWise pricing, margin, and commercial standards.
* Negotiate contract terms, discounts, and implementation scope where required.
* Average sales cycle expectation: 25–30 days.
* Qualify and develop opportunities within existing accounts to maintain a healthy, repeatable pipeline.
* Provide accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasts.
* Track and report on key metrics including renewals, churn, expansion, and partner performance.
* Maintain high standards of CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.
* Develop and execute territory and account plans aligned to partner goals and regional strategy.
* Segment partners based on ICP fit, maturity, and growth potential.
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Partner teams to align on partner strategy and execution.
* Follow the ConnectWise value‑ and solution‑based sales methodology.
* Comfortable with regular outbound activity, including 40–50 partner interactions per day.



  





**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:** 



* Strong understanding of the Nordic MSP and IT channel ecosystem, including distributor‑led partner models.
* Knowledge of MSP, TSP, and security‑focused technology markets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
* Organised, detail‑oriented, and effective in prioritising multiple partners.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
* Proficiency in Salesforce, Outreach, and modern sales tooling.



  





**Educational/Vocational/Previous Experience Recommendations:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent business experience
* 3 years of experience in account management, client success, or sales.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding client satisfaction and retention targets.
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and reporting software.



  





**Working Conditions:** 



* Onsite/Hybrid depending on location
* 0-10% travel may be required

ConnectWise provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military/veteran status, marital status, familial or parental status, or any other characteristic or status protected by applicable federal, state and local laws.***

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please contact us at talentacquisition@connectwise.com or 1-800-671-6898.***

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
description:
**TL;DR** 
 – We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineering Lead to help scale the future of AI-powered software creation. You'll build and lead the FDE team and partner with our most ambitious customers to turn ideas into real products. This is still a hands-on role: you'll design, write, and ship production code alongside your team, while partnering with our other FDE leaders to shape how the function operates globally. It's a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems that no one has solved before.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Most engineering leadership roles move you away from the code. This one keeps you close to the craft and the customer.
   

  

 You'll build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who partner with our customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving hard technical problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn't just to make individual deployments succeed. It's to spot what should become part of the Lovable platform and act on it.
   

  

 As one of a small group of FDE leaders, you'll set the technical bar for the function and help define how it scales, from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it works with customers and our core product teams.
   

  

 If you want to build an exceptional engineering team without stepping away from building yourself, this is that role.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 12+ years across software engineering, technical architecture, and customer-facing engineering
* Experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams
* A track record of remaining deeply hands-on as your leadership scope has grown
