title: Systemutvecklare .NET, Sthlm
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vill du utveckla system som bidrar till ett mer effektivt och fungerande samhälle? Hos oss arbetar du med lösningar inom bland annat vård, energi och telekom där kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet är avgörande.
   

  

 Som
 **.NET-utvecklare** 
 hos oss arbetar du som konsult i långsiktiga uppdrag tillsammans med kollegor och kund. Uppdragen varierar från vidareutveckling av befintliga system till nyutveckling och modernisering. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen och är med och fattar tekniska beslut som påverkar lösningarnas kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet. Hos oss får du arbeta i agila teamleveranser tillsammans med utvecklare, arkitekter, testare och verksamhet, där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Läs mer här.
   

  

**Det här erbjuder Sopra Steria dig**
 Hos oss kombinerar du stabiliteten i ett etablerat bolag med en kultur präglad av samarbete, kunskapsdelning och hög teknisk kompetens. Du arbetar i varierande uppdrag med möjlighet att utvecklas vidare inom både teknik och arkitektur tillsammans med erfarna kollegor.
   

  

**Några av våra förmåner**
* 5 000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag samt hälsostöd
* 30 dagars semester samt två extra lediga dagar per år
* Certifieringsbonus och kompetensutveckling
* Föräldralön, tjänstepension och försäkringar
* Bidrag till hemmakontor och arbetsutrustning


**Det här kommer du att göra**
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla .NET-lösningar i komplexa uppdrag
* Vara delaktig i tekniska beslut, design och implementation
* Arbeta nära kund och team i agila leveranser
* Bidra till kvalitet, säkerhet och hållbara lösningar
* Dela kunskap och stötta kollegor i tekniska frågor


**Teknisk miljö**
 Du arbetar genom hela stacken med backend i .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core och REST API:er samt databaser via Entity Framework Core och SQL Server. På frontend arbetar vi med TypeScript och React eller Angular. Våra leveranser bedrivs agilt med fokus på kvalitet och samarbete.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har**
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av .NET och C#
* Erfarenhet av ASP.NET Core, API-utveckling och databaser
* Erfarenhet av moderna webbtekniker i JavaScript eller TypeScript
* Erfarenhet av att bygga eller vidareutveckla robusta system
* Trivs i eller är nyfiken på konsultrollen
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av Azure eller annan molnplattform
* Erfarenhet av mikrotjänster eller integrationslösningar
* DevOps-arbetssätt inom exempelvis CI/CD och containerteknik


**Rekryteringsprocessen**
 Rollen ställer höga krav på kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet. Inför eventuell anställning genomför vi bakgrundskontroll och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

 📩 Har du frågor om rollen? Kontakta gärna Clara Bozzi på clara.bozzi@soprasteria.com.

title: Vertical Account Manager
description:
As Vertical Account Manager, you will act as the primary Siemens commercial lead in the Nordic region for hyperscaler accounts and work closely with the global account team. Located in the Nordics Data Center Sales team, you will be responsible for customer engagement, offer preparation, stakeholder coordination and business growth.
   

  

 You will help ensure that projects are acquired on commercially sustainable terms, enabling successful execution and supporting project delivery. The role combines customer and account management with commercial ownership, contract management, cross-functional coordination and long-term account development.
   

  

**The Role**
* Act as the primary local commercial interface for hyperscaler accounts, building strong relationships with customers and key project stakeholders.
* Own the commercial strategy for assigned opportunities and projects, including negotiations, contract clarifications and internal approvals.
* Manage commercial risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle, including change orders and claims.
* Assess the commercial impact of design, scope and schedule changes and ensure appropriate cost recovery.
* Coordinate across sales, project management, engineering, service and global account teams to ensure effective stakeholder alignment.
* Drive long-term account development by identifying opportunities for additional solutions, lifecycle services and future business.


 Your contribution will be measured through profitable offers, effective change order and claim recovery, strong customer stakeholder relationships, and growth of Siemens’ hyperscaler business while maintaining the target margin and risk profile. You will also contribute to a positive and engaged team culture by sharing learnings, supporting team development and recognizing key project successes.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Strong commercial, contract management and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and build strong relationships in complex customer and project environments.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Self-driven and structured, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced project environment.
* Experience working in a complex matrix organization and coordinating stakeholders across countries, business units and functions.
* A proven track record and a minimum of five years' experience within the data center industry, critical infrastructure, or large-scale project environments, ideally including Hyperscaler


 accounts, would be considered a strong asset.
   

  

* Fluent English is required. A Nordic language (Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian or Danish) is recommended but not mandatory.


**Education**
* Holds a master’s degree in electrical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable commercial discipline.


**About Smart Infrastructure**
 Siemens Smart Infrastructure (SI) is shaping the market for intelligent, adaptive infrastructure for today and the future. It addresses the pressing challenges of urbanization and climate change by connecting energy systems, buildings and industries. SI has a strong position within Data Center Vertical which is one of Siemens growth verticals. You can read about Siemens at www.siemens.com
   

  

**Interested?**
 Then don’t hesitate to apply! We are looking forward to receiving your CV and cover letter. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

title: IT-Handläggare
description:
Vill du bidra till Sveriges säkerhet i en digitaliserad värld?
   

  

 Cyberförsvar ingår i Försvarsmaktens huvuduppgift som en integrerad del av det militära försvar som ska kunna möte att väpnat angrepp. Cyberförsvaret genomför operationer i cyberdomänen och tillför handlingsalternativ som ligger utanför de reguljära förbandens förmågor. Vår uppgift är att upptäcka, identifiera och avvärja hot från de mest kvalificerade aktörerna inom cyberdomänen. Vi försvarar Försvarsmaktens ledningssystem och kritisk infrastruktur genom både proaktiv uppsökande verksamhet och reaktiv hantering av IT-säkerhetsincidenter. Då vår verksamhet innebär skarp verksamhet inom både offensiva och defensiva cyberoperationer kommer du vara den del i försvaret av Sverige och att stärka vår samlade förmåga inom cyberdomänen. Ett starkt cyberförsvar är avgörande för vår förmåga att försvara Sveriges demokrati och vår frihet att leva som vi själva väljer.
   

  

 Vi söker en engagerad och serviceinriktad IT-handläggare som vill bidra med att tillse att våra system fungerar på Cyberförsvarsledningen (CFL).
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett kvalificerat arbete med ett meningsfullt uppdrag – att bidra till att värna vårt öppna samhälle. Vi värdesätter ömsesidigt förtroende och hos oss får du ett eget ansvar och goda möjligheter att kompetensutvecklas.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss och vår verksamhet här: Cyberförsvar
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Ledningssystemsektionen ansvarar för att driva och utveckla arbetet med verksamhetsförmågor kopplade till informationsbehov, processer och IT-stöd. Här kommer du arbeta nära både verksamheten och IT-styrningen. Här får du möjlighet att påverka, förbättra och skapa långsiktigt hållbara lösningar i en komplex och samhällsviktig miljö.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT samt som motiveras av att skapa struktur, tydlighet och värde för andra.
   

  

 Du har ett naturligt servicetänk, är lösningsorienterad och har förmågan att se både helhet och detaljer.
   

  

 Som IT-handläggare kommer du att tillse att ansvara för att IT-stöd och IT-administration utförs. Arbetet innebär ett nära samarbete med kollegor. Befattningen ställer höga krav på god kommunikation- och samarbetsförmåga och problemlösning.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
 Du kommer att ansvara för genomförande av aktiviteter för att utveckla och vidmakthålla processer och IT-stöd inom Försvarsmaktens cyberverksamhet. Du kommer även att hantera beställningar och inköp av IT-relaterad materiel. Du är den som kollegorna vänder sig till med stöd kring våra IT system.
   

  

**KRAV**
**Kvalifikationer**
* Gymnasieutbildning inom IT, el eller teknik, alternativt annan likvärdig utbildning/erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant.
* Några års aktuell erfarenhet från att felsöka, åtgärda och komma med förslag på åtgärder inom IT
* Mycket god datorvana med kunskaper både i Linux och Windows.
* Goda kunskaper att uttrycka dig i både tal och skrift på svenska och engelska


**Personliga egenskaper**
 För oss är det viktigt att du anpassningsbar, strukturerad, och serviceinriktad. Du behöver kunna förhålla dig till deadlines och leverera med kvalitet. Du har ett väl utvecklat ordningssinne. Att arbeta självständigt är en förutsättning precis som att arbeta i team. För oss är det viktigt att du har god kommunikations- och samarbetsförmåga.
   

  

 Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av Signalskyddsmateriel
* Erfarenhet av att jobba med system som ställer höga krav på säkerhet.
* Kännedom om Försvarsmaktens IT-system
* Erfarenhet av arbete i statlig myndighet
* B Körkort


 Hos oss värdesätter vi olika perspektiv och erfarenheter – vi välkomnar därför sökanden med olika bakgrunder.
   

  

**Övriga krav**
 Du bör inte berätta att du har sökt tjänst hos CFL för andra personer än dina närmast berörda. Anledningen till att vi ber dig vara återhållsam med information är att vissa tjänster vid förbandet omfattas av sekretess. Med anställning följer nationell och internationell arbetsskyldighet. Urvalsprocessen kommer att kompletteras med arbetspsykologiska tester.
   

  

**Övrigt**
 Anställningsform: Civil tillsvidareanställning. Försvarsmakten tillämpar sex månaders provanställning för dig som inte är anställd i myndigheten.
   

  

 Sysselsättningsgrad: Heltid.
   

  

 Arbetsort: Stockholm.
   

  

 Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Resor till andra orter i landet förekommer. Individuell lönesättning tillämpas. I din arbetstid ingår 3 timmars träning i veckan.
   

  

**Upplysningar om befattningen eller rekryteringsprocessen:**
 Kontakta cyberintresse@mil.se
   

  

**Fackliga företrädare:**
 Nås via cyberintresse@mil.se
   

  

**Ansökan
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-15. Skicka CV samt personligt brev till** 
 cyberintresse@mil.se
   

  

 Din ansökan ska innehålla CV och ansökningsbrev där du motiverar varför du är lämpad för denna befattningen samt svarar på dessa två urvalsfrågor:
   

  

* Har du några års aktuell erfarenhet från att felsöka, åtgärda och komma med förslag på lösningar?


 Om Ja, vänligen beskriv din erfarenhet
   

  

* Har du vana av att arbeta serviceinriktat?


**OBS! Kom ihåg att ange referens i din ansökan: [9014]**
 ,
 **Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.** 
 ----------------------------------------------------- Information om det rekryterande förbandet: I Högkvarteret finns överbefälhavaren och generaldirektören. Högkvarteret har ungefär 1 000 medarbetare – både yrkesofficerare och civila experter. Högkvarteret utgörs från 2023-01-01 av försvarsstaben, operationsledningen, militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten, samt Högkvarterets stabsavdelning och fristående enheter för tillsyn. En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. I anställningen ingår även en skyldighet att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: Account Executive SMB - EMEA
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The role**
 As an Account Executive SMB at Legora, you will play a key role in driving our growth by managing the full sales cycle — from qualifying leads to running demos and closing deals. You’ll engage inbound prospects, nurture relationships, and collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to align on campaigns and optimize conversion.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Own inbound leads of prospects. Manage top of funnel conversion through qualification, demo, through close.
* Manage full sales cycles of opportunities. Run tight discovery calls and need assessments to evaluate fit against our ideal customer profile. Your job is to connect dots quickly and accurately.
* Nurture leads. Keep momentum alive with smart, value-driven follow-up that guides prospects through the early stages of the journey.
* Partner with Sales & Marketing. Align with campaign priorities and collaborate closely with GTM stakeholders to drive results
* Keep the pipeline clean. Log activity in Salesforce and enable clear forecasting and reporting.
* Surface market insight. Feedback what you hear on the frontlines to help us sharpen messaging, positioning, and targeting.
* Support events & campaigns. Engage leads pre- and post-event, helping make sure our campaigns generate real commercial outcomes.


**We’re Looking For**
* 3+ years experience in a customer facing Sales or a Sales Associate role. Ideally in SaaS, tech, or financial services. A SDR, BDR background is beneficial.
* Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Strong communication skills: persuasive, concise, and human in writing and in speech.
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple outreach streams at once.
* A curious, motivated learner with strong instincts for prioritization.
* Resilience and drive: you take feedback well, act fast, and don’t let a no slow you down.
* A collaborative mindset: you’re team-first and know how to hand off, sync up, and help others win.
* This is a Stockholm-based, 5-day in-office role, we believe building together in person drives better outcomes.


**What's In It For You**
* The opportunity to launch your GTM career at a legal AI company with true product–market fit.
* Direct exposure to senior sales leadership and the chance to learn by doing: fast.
* Structured onboarding, regular coaching, and clear paths for growth.
* A fast-moving environment where your insights shape how we scale.
* Competitive base salary, uncapped variable compensation, and equity upside.
* Centrally located offices in Stockholm, London, and NYC, designed as a space for you to do your life's work.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Account Manager till Sveriges äldsta CRM-bolag!
description:
*Vill du utvecklas inom B2B-försäljning hos ett entreprenöriellt, dynamiskt och väletablerat CRM-bolag? Här får du chansen att kliva in i ett internationellt team i Stockholm, i en roll som anpassas efter din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner. Oavsett om du vill ta nästa stora kliv eller redan är en etablerad säljare väntar en spännande tillväxtresa!* 




  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Vår kund är Sveriges äldsta CRM-bolag och kombinerar managementkonsultation med IT-kompetens för att skapa skräddarsydda tekniska lösningar. Med kunder inom bland annat tillverkningsindustrin och en global närvaro i fem länder har de byggt en solid grund för att hjälpa företag världen över att optimera sina affärsprocesser. Genom dagliga globala avstämningar får medarbetarna ett starkt internationellt nätverk för kunskapsutbyte och samarbete. Trots att bolaget grundades 2008 är det fortsatt ett entreprenörsdrivet bolag, vilket avspeglar sig i att beslutsvägarna är korta och passar dig som drivs av att bygga vidare på något snarare än att förvalta.
 



  





 Nu vill de utöka säljteamet med en driven säljare för den svenska marknaden. Vi välkomnar sökande på olika nivåer – oavsett om du har några års erfarenhet och är hungrig på att ta nästa stora kliv i karriären, eller redan är en etablerad Senior Account Manager som vill växa i en internationell miljö.
 



  





 Rollen kommer till viss del kunna anpassas utifrån din erfarenhet. Till dig som befinner dig i startskottet av din säljkarriär kommer du erbjudas stöttning och coachning i kundmöten och affärsprocesser genom bland annat medlyssning och sambesök, medan du som är senior snabbt kastas in och får ta ett större eget ansvar för stora säljbudgetar och strategiska konton. Tjänsten rapporterar direkt till VD.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 




**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden kommer bestå av att:** 



* Proaktivt identifiera och kontakta potentiella kunder (bl.a. via LinkedIn Sales Navigator och nätverkande).
* Boka och genomföra kundmöten, med starkt stöd från marknadsavdelningen som levererar kvalitativt material.
* Driva säljprocessen från första kontakt till förhandling och avslut.
* Delta i dagliga internationella säljmöten för att utbyta insikter och strategier med globala kollegor.



  





**Vi söker dig som har** 



* Erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning, gärna inom IT, SaaS eller CRM (meriterande med kunskap inom Salesforce eller Microsoft).
* Flytande kunskaper inom svenska och engelska, då språken används i det dagliga arbetet



  





 Det är även meriterande om du som söker har en avklarad eftergymnasial utbildning, föredragsvis inom IT, systemvetenskap och/eller försäljning, men vi kommer väga dina erfarenheter och dokumenterade resultat högre.
 



  





 Som person besitter du ett starkt affärsdriv, god kommunikationsförmåga och ett intresse av att bygga långsiktiga och framgångsrika kundrelationer. Du är en "doer" och har ett tydligt framåtlut, samtidigt som du är prestigelös och ödmjuk i ditt tillvägagångssätt.
 



  





**Vår rekryteringsprocess** 




 Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Thesis Project – AI as an Engineering Aid
description:
Sandvik Coromant is a world-leading supplier of tools and tooling systems for metal cutting. Behind that sits a production environment with a large installed base of automation equipment – some of it still running on Adept robot controllers programmed in V+.

  

This thesis project covers AI as an engineering aid when modernizing legacy Adept/V+ robot installations.

  

This is a proof-of-concept project with honest premises. We do not believe AI can replace robot, PLC, and safety engineers in a control system migration, and we are not asking you to prove that it can. What we want to know is something more useful: how much of the manual groundwork involved in such a migration can AI take off our hands?

### **Background and scope of the project**


Parts of our production still rely on obsolete Adept/V+ robot controllers, while the mechanical equipment has many years of useful life left. Modernization is often postponed because it requires engineers to interpret undocumented code, reconstruct system behavior, and create documentation and tests. Although the architectural differences make automatic translation unrealistic, AI could support this groundwork through analysis, documentation, code drafts, and test generation.

### **Purpose**


The purpose of the project is to quantify, on a single small and well-defined part of a real V+ application, how much AI can contribute in four specific areas:

* Analysis – understanding and explaining existing V+ code, its structure, dependencies and behavior
* Documentation – producing the functional and technical documentation that is missing today
* Code drafts – generating first-draft code for the target platform for an engineer to review and complete
* Test generation – deriving test cases and verification criteria from the original application

  

For each area we want a measured answer: how much of the work could AI do, what was the quality, how much rework did an engineer have to put in, and how much time was saved in total?

### **What this project is not**


The goal is explicitly not a fully automated, production-ready conversion. Success is a clear, well-substantiated picture of where AI helps and where it does not and a working method we can reuse. A result showing limited benefit is a perfectly acceptable outcome. We are after an honest answer, not a positive one.

### **Work description**


The project runs as a proof of concept in five phases. All verification is done virtually against a 3D model; no commissioning on physical equipment is involved.

  

1. Scoping and reference behavior

* Together with your supervisor, select one small and well-defined part of a V+ application – a single sub-sequence or program module – as the case for the whole project
* Establish a measurable reference behavior for that part – motions, I/O, sequence logic and interfaces to surrounding equipment. This is what every later result is judged against
* Define up front how AI contribution will be measured in each of the four areas, so the comparison is fair and repeatable

  

2. AI-assisted analysis

* Use two or three AI tools to interpret and explain the V+ code: structure, control flow, dependencies and implicit assumptions
* Assess correctness against the reference behavior – what did the tools understand, what did they miss, and what did they state confidently but wrongly?

  

3. AI-assisted documentation

* Generate functional and technical documentation of the selected part with AI support
* Evaluate how much of the output is usable as-is, how much needs editing, and how it compares with documenting the same code manually

  

4. AI-assisted code drafts and test generation

* Produce first-draft code for the target platform with AI support, intended for engineering review rather than direct use
* Generate test cases and verification criteria from the original application
* Document failure patterns systematically. Where the tools go wrong is at least as valuable a result as where they succeed

  

5. Verification against a 3D model, and recommendation

* Build a simplified kinematic 3D model of the equipment – reusing existing CAD material where it exists – and run the reviewed code against it to verify motions, sequence and I/O against the reference behavior
* Summarize the measured AI contribution per area, with an estimate of time and cost saved compared with a fully manual approach
* Recommend how Sandvik Coromant should work with AI support in future modernizations, which steps to use it for, which to keep entirely in engineering hands, and what is needed to scale the method

### **Scope and limitations**

* The work covers one small part of one V+ application, not a complete program or machine
* Verification is virtual. Commissioning on physical equipment is not included
* The 3D model is kinematic and limited in scope. Physics modelling, cycle time optimization and full mechatronic simulation are out of scope
* The project covers control and software, not mechanical rebuild
* Safety functions are analyzed and documented, but safety design and certification remain with our engineers and are not delegated to AI tools in this project

### **Location**


In place at Gimo, Sweden.

### **Student background**


We are looking for one student with an interest in automation and a healthy skepticism towards tools that produce confident-looking output.

  

What you bring:

* You are in the final year of a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field
* Basic knowledge of PLC programming and/or industrial robotics
* Interest in simulation and virtual commissioning (experience with CAD or 3D simulation is an advantage)
* You work systematically and critically, and are comfortable measuring and documenting results rather than only building things
* Good communication skills in English or Swedish

  

Experience of AI tools for software development is a plus.

### **Our culture**


At Sandvik, we’re tech-driven, innovative, and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort, so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. We invest in supporting each other, learning together, and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn, or Facebook to get to know us better.

### **Duration of the project**


The thesis project corresponds to 30 credits and lasts approximately 20 weeks, starting at the beginning of 2027. Upon completion and approval of the thesis, Sandvik offers lump-sum compensation.

### **Contact information**


For further information about this project, please contact Jacob Bexenius, Engineering Blanks Manager, +46 (0)76-767 39 97.

  

We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use, and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.

### **How to apply**


We have an ongoing selection process for this project and ask you to send your application as soon as possible, but no later than November 20, 2026. Click Apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by email. Job ID: R0097667.

title: Functional Safety Engineer
description:
**Functional Safety Engineer**
==============================


Vill du ta nästa steg inom Functional Safety och arbeta nära teknikutvecklingen i en snabbt växande och innovativ bransch?

  

Vi söker en Functional Safety Engineer som vill vara med och skapa trygga, smarta och hållbara fordon genom strukturerat säkerhetsarbete och moderna utvecklingsmetoder.

  

I den här rollen får du möjlighet att kombinera teknik, analys och kommunikation i ett team där samarbete, nyfikenhet och kvalitet står i centrum.

  

**DINA ANSVARSOMRÅDEN:**

  

I rollen som Functional Safety Engineer arbetar du nära utvecklingsteamen för att säkerställa att säkerhetskraven följs genom hela produktens livscykel. Du stödjer mekatronik , mjukvaru och systemingenjörer i arbetet med att implementera funktionella säkerhetsaspekter och ser till att utvecklingen sker i enlighet med ISO 26262. Genom att arbeta i verktyg som SystemWeaver, DOORS eller Elektra hanterar du säkerhetsrelaterade krav och skapar spårbarhet mellan specifikation, implementation och testresultat.

  

Du använder även MATLAB/Simulink för att analysera funktioner och bidra till att säkerhetskrav förstås och implementeras korrekt. En del av rollen innebär att delta i verifierings och valideringsaktiviteter, samt att säkerställa att utvecklingsprocesserna följer kvalitetsramverk som Automotive SPICE och CMMI.

  

I ditt dagliga arbete samarbetar du tvärfunktionellt både internt och externt – med kollegor, leverantörer och andra tekniska parter – för att samla in information, utreda frågeställningar och bidra till att lösningar håller hög säkerhets- och kvalitetsnivå. Du deltar i möten och tekniska reviews där du representerar säkerhetsperspektivet och arbetar aktivt för att säkerställa att både funktion och kvalitet uppfyller projektens krav.

  

**DIN PROFIL:**

  

Vi söker dig som brinner för säkerhet, systemutveckling och avancerad teknik – och som trivs i en roll där struktur, kommunikation och analysförmåga är avgörande.

  

Vi tror att du har:


* Erfarenhet av arbete med Functional Safety inom fordonsutveckling.
* En kandidatexamen eller master inom mekatronik, mjukvara, elektroteknik eller motsvarande område.
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet inom Functional Safety domänen.
* Goda kunskaper om ISO 26262.
* Erfarenhet av MATLAB/Simulink och kravhanteringsverktyg (SystemWeaver, DOORS, Elektra eller liknande).
* Vana vid att arbeta enligt mjukvaru- och kvalitetsprocesser såsom CMMI och Automotive SPICE.
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska
* B körkort.
  

**Som person**
  

Du är en kommunikativ och samarbetsinriktad person som enkelt bygger relationer och trivs i tvärfunktionella team. Din positiva och lösningsfokuserade inställning gör att du tar dig an komplexa frågor med nyfikenhet och driv, och du har en stark vilja att utvecklas och kontinuerligt lära nytt.

  

I ditt arbete är du strukturerad, analytisk och noggrann, och du har lätt för att sätta dig in i tekniska samband och bidra med tydliga, konstruktiva perspektiv. Du trivs med att arbeta enligt etablerade processer samtidigt som du är flexibel nog att anpassa dig när projekten kräver det.

  

**VI ERBJUDER:**

  

På AVL blir du en del av ett globalt teknikföretag som ligger i framkant av utveckling, simulering och testning inom mobilitetens framtid. Som världens största oberoende aktör inom området, med över 12 000 medarbetare internationellt, driver vi innovation för en grönare, säkrare och bättre värld av mobilitet.

  

Vårt fokus sträcker sig över hela värdekedjan – från tidiga idé- och konceptfaser till industrialisering och serieproduktion. Vi arbetar med avancerad teknik inom elektrifiering, mjukvara, autonom körning, digitalisering och energieffektiva drivlinor, och hjälper våra kunder att forma framtidens mobilitetslösningar.

  

Hos oss får du en arbetsplats där du kan växa, påverka och vara med och driva teknikutvecklingen framåt – som gör verklig skillnad för framtidens mobilitet!

  

**Intresserad?**

  

I den här rekryteringsprocessen tillämpar vi löpande urval. Rekryteringsprocessen kan gå snabbt och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

  

Interna medarbetare inom AVL är varmt välkomna att ansöka.

title: Requirements Management Engineer
description:
Req ID:530317

  



At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  


**Could you be the** **Requirements Management Engineer (RME)****in Stockholm or Västerås we’re looking for?**  


**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your **Requirement Management** expertise in a new cutting-edge field.  



The Nordic Technology Center of Alstom is an internal development and supplier organization for train onboard signaling; train control and communication system. The organization is global with sites in Sweden, Germany, Switzerland, France, and India. The team in Stockholm and Västerås is responsible for computers legacy control and communication products as well as new, input and output products, and human machine interface products. We are now investing in new products with increased performance, cyber security protection and increased functionality.  



As Requirements Management Engineer (RME) you shall be a key user for requirement tools , manage requirement structure and support multiple programs by providing guidelines, coaching and training team members for the management and writing requirements. You will collaborate daily with the Program Development Managers, System Architects and engineering teams.  


**We will look to you for:**
* Implement Requirement Management processes for product development
* Administrate and be key user for Requirement Management tool
* Drive the engineers in their requirements development activities
* Verify the data quality & consistency in the Requirement Management database
* Manage the requirements changes & configuration
* Be the first line contact for Requirement Management queries

title: Thesis Project – AI as an Engineering Aid
description:
Sandvik Coromant is a world-leading supplier of tools and tooling systems for metal cutting. Behind that sits a production environment with a large installed base of automation equipment – some of it still running on Adept robot controllers programmed in V+.  



  

This thesis project covers AI as an engineering aid when modernizing legacy Adept/V+ robot installations.  



  

This is a proof-of-concept project with honest premises. We do not believe AI can replace robot, PLC, and safety engineers in a control system migration, and we are not asking you to prove that it can. What we want to know is something more useful: how much of the manual groundwork involved in such a migration can AI take off our hands?  



  

### **Background and scope of the project**

Parts of our production still rely on obsolete Adept/V+ robot controllers, while the mechanical equipment has many years of useful life left. Modernization is often postponed because it requires engineers to interpret undocumented code, reconstruct system behavior, and create documentation and tests. Although the architectural differences make automatic translation unrealistic, AI could support this groundwork through analysis, documentation, code drafts, and test generation.  



  

### **Purpose**

The purpose of the project is to quantify, on a single small and well-defined part of a real V+ application, how much AI can contribute in four specific areas:


* Analysis – understanding and explaining existing V+ code, its structure, dependencies and behavior
* Documentation – producing the functional and technical documentation that is missing today
* Code drafts – generating first-draft code for the target platform for an engineer to review and complete

Test generation – deriving test cases and verification criteria from the original application  

* 

  

For each area we want a measured answer: how much of the work could AI do, what was the quality, how much rework did an engineer have to put in, and how much time was saved in total?  



  

### **What this project is not**

The goal is explicitly not a fully automated, production-ready conversion. Success is a clear, well-substantiated picture of where AI helps and where it does not and a working method we can reuse. A result showing limited benefit is a perfectly acceptable outcome. We are after an honest answer, not a positive one.  



  

### **Work description**

The project runs as a proof of concept in five phases. All verification is done virtually against a 3D model; no commissioning on physical equipment is involved.  



  

1. Scoping and reference behavior


* Together with your supervisor, select one small and well-defined part of a V+ application – a single sub-sequence or program module – as the case for the whole project
* Establish a measurable reference behavior for that part – motions, I/O, sequence logic and interfaces to surrounding equipment. This is what every later result is judged against

Define up front how AI contribution will be measured in each of the four areas, so the comparison is fair and repeatable  

* 

  

2. AI-assisted analysis


* Use two or three AI tools to interpret and explain the V+ code: structure, control flow, dependencies and implicit assumptions

Assess correctness against the reference behavior – what did the tools understand, what did they miss, and what did they state confidently but wrongly?  

* 

  

3. AI-assisted documentation


* Generate functional and technical documentation of the selected part with AI support

Evaluate how much of the output is usable as-is, how much needs editing, and how it compares with documenting the same code manually  

* 

  

4. AI-assisted code drafts and test generation


* Produce first-draft code for the target platform with AI support, intended for engineering review rather than direct use
* Generate test cases and verification criteria from the original application

Document failure patterns systematically. Where the tools go wrong is at least as valuable a result as where they succeed  

* 

  

5. Verification against a 3D model, and recommendation


* Build a simplified kinematic 3D model of the equipment – reusing existing CAD material where it exists – and run the reviewed code against it to verify motions, sequence and I/O against the reference behavior
* Summarize the measured AI contribution per area, with an estimate of time and cost saved compared with a fully manual approach

Recommend how Sandvik Coromant should work with AI support in future modernizations, which steps to use it for, which to keep entirely in engineering hands, and what is needed to scale the method  

* 

  

### **Scope and limitations**

* The work covers one small part of one V+ application, not a complete program or machine
* Verification is virtual. Commissioning on physical equipment is not included
* The 3D model is kinematic and limited in scope. Physics modelling, cycle time optimization and full mechatronic simulation are out of scope
* The project covers control and software, not mechanical rebuild

Safety functions are analyzed and documented, but safety design and certification remain with our engineers and are not delegated to AI tools in this project  

* 

  

### **Location**

In place at Gimo, Sweden.  



  

### **Student background**

We are looking for one student with an interest in automation and a healthy skepticism towards tools that produce confident-looking output.  



  

What you bring:


* You are in the final year of a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field
* Basic knowledge of PLC programming and/or industrial robotics
* Interest in simulation and virtual commissioning (experience with CAD or 3D simulation is an advantage)
* You work systematically and critically, and are comfortable measuring and documenting results rather than only building things

Good communication skills in English or Swedish  

* 

  

Experience of AI tools for software development is a plus.  



  

### **Our culture**

At Sandvik, we’re tech-driven, innovative, and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort, so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. We invest in supporting each other, learning together, and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub , LinkedIn , or Facebook to get to know us better.  



### **Duration of the project**

The thesis project corresponds to 30 credits and lasts approximately 20 weeks, starting at the beginning of 2027. Upon completion and approval of the thesis, Sandvik offers lump-sum compensation.  



  

### **Contact information**

For further information about this project, please contact Jacob Bexenius, Engineering Blanks Manager, +46 (0)76-767 39 97.  



We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use, and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.  



### **How to apply**

We have an ongoing selection process for this project and ask you to send your application as soon as possible, but no later than November 20, 2026. Click Apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by email. Job ID: R0097667.

title: Master´s thesis - Engineering Adaptive User Interfaces for Industrial Automation Systems
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


R&D Team Lead **Your role and responsibilities**  

Industrial operators increasingly supervise highly automated systems through digital interfaces. While automation can reduce routine work, operators are often required to understand and respond to dynamically changing complex situations when they occur. Helping users access relevant information, understand context, and make informed decisions therefore remains an important challenge.

  

Recent advances in AI and interactive technologies create new opportunities for adaptive interfaces that dynamically support operators based on operational context. In this thesis, adaptation is scoped to two dimensions: task context (e.g., operational phase, alarm states) and information relevance (e.g., which data is pertinent to the current situation). Adaptations are realized through changes in visual presentation, such as layout and level of detail in process graphic maps, rather than personalization based on individual user profiles. This thesis explores how such concepts can be engineered into functional prototypes.

  

This Master’s thesis aims to explore how adaptive industrial interface concepts can be technically realized with emerging new technologies.

 *Main research questions:*

* *What methods and technologies could be used to effectively engineer an interface that automatically change its visual presentations according to tasks and users’ current needs?*
* *How can we make process graphic maps more dynamic and adaptive, with emerging smart technologies?*

 **Details:**

* Spring 2027, commonly between Jan-June
* 30 ECTS/högskolepoäng (hp)
* 1 - 2 students
* In Västerås, possibility for hybrid workplace

 **Your responsibilities**

* State-of-the-art review: Investigate current research and solution in: Technical solutions to create adaptive and intelligent user interfaces, dynamic HMI, future industrial interaction paradigms
* Investigate key methods to implement adaptive interface and dynamic HMI and summarize pros and cons of them based on literature.
* Explore design and implementation challenges: Analyze existing adaptive interface solutions and identify challenges in moving from concepts to working systems.
* Experiment different tools
* Design and implement one or more functional prototype demo. Possible examples include: Intelligent process graphic maps; Context-aware alarm assistance; Intelligent information prioritization;.
* Evaluate prototype concepts (optional)
* Summarize findings: produce recommendations, design implications and future opportunities for adaptive industrial interfaces

 **Your background**


We are looking for motivated master's students with a strong interest in human-centered design and automation.  



  

Candidates could have:

* **Academic Background** in one or more of the following fields:
	+ Computer science
	+ Software Engineering
	+ Intelligent Systems
	+ Information Technology
	+ Human-Centred AI
	+ Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)

Recruiting Manager Dawid Ziobro, dawid.ziobro@se.abb.com, will answer your questions.

  

Apply with your CV, academic transcripts and a cover letter in English.


We look forward to receiving your application!


A future opportunity


This role is part of our talent pipeline, which means it’s not currently open, but we’re always looking for curious minds, bold thinkers, and people who want to make an impact.


Click Apply to express your interest and be considered for future opportunities that match your experience and aspirations.


At ABB, we welcome people from all backgrounds and believe that diverse perspectives help us build a cleaner, smarter future.


Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about how we help run what runs the world.

title: Frontend Team Lead Simulation Software
description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to develop web-based functionality for COMSOL Multiphysics® and related products. In this hands-on role, you will combine software development in TypeScript and Vue with technical leadership, team management, and coordination of the team’s development projects, working on software used by engineers and researchers around the world. About COMSOL COMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems.
  
  

Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide. Role Based in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.
  
  

Your main focus will be web frontend development for functionality that extends how our customers work with simulation software. This includes tools for managing simulation models and data, running and interacting with simulations, and making simulation functionality available to different users and computing environments. One example is the Model Manager, our process and data management system for simulation modeling. Other projects cover areas such as simulation apps, computational workflows, and functionality for deploying and using simulation models in new contexts.
  
  

The projects evolve together with the COMSOL product suite, and you will have the opportunity to work on both established functionality and new product areas. The common challenge is to create intuitive web interfaces for sophisticated engineering software, often bringing together frontend development with complex underlying functionality and large amounts of technical data. As team lead, you will remain closely involved in software development while also managing the team and its projects. You will write and review code, contribute to product and technical design, make technical decisions, plan development projects, and guide and support the developers in the team.
  
  

You will be responsible for creating an environment where the team can deliver high-quality software and grow professionally. Our web frontends are part of engineering software products rather than continuously deployed web services. The functionality you develop is released as part of software that our customers install and operate in their own environments. This brings challenges in areas such as compatibility, upgrades, performance, security, and long-term maintainability, and calls for careful design of functionality that will remain part of the products for years.
  
  

Qualifications For this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer who combines strong technical skills with the ability to manage a development team and its projects. We are looking for the following qualifications: M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related field. Excellent programming skills and several years of professional software development experience.
  
  

Experience developing substantial web frontends using TypeScript or JavaScript and a modern frontend framework. Experience taking technical responsibility for software projects or significant areas of a product. Good communication and organizational skills, with the ability to set priorities, make decisions, and support other developers in their work. Experience with the following will be highly valued: Vue, React, or similar component-based frontend frameworks.
  
  

Managing or coordinating a software development team. Project management within software development. Mentoring developers and providing constructive technical feedback. Planning larger development projects and coordinating work between developers.
  
  

Designing and evolving user interfaces for complex applications. Large software projects and mature codebases. Software that is installed and operated in customer environments. No background in physics or simulation is required.
  
  

At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering. Working at COMSOL At COMSOL, frontend development is closely connected to the products as a whole. You will work on functionality that makes sophisticated simulation capabilities accessible in new ways, as part of an organization where many different areas of expertise contribute to the same product family. New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects.
  
  

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape both the software and the development of your team, while remaining closely involved in hands-on software development. We also offer: A competitive salary Individual pension plans Sponsored gym membership Work-life balance with regular working hours This role is primarily based in our Stockholm office, where in-person collaboration is an important part of working with and supporting the team. We also offer flexibility to work from home when compatible with the needs of the team and the role. To Apply Does this sound interesting?
  
  

Submit your application in English or Swedish using the form below. Make sure to include: Cover letter CV University diploma with grades Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered. To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.
  
  

For more information, contact Mikael Sterner at tel. 08-412 95 00. We review applications continuously.

title: Senior Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.


We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a **Senior Fullstack AI Engineer** in our **Stockholm** office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?


### **The Role**


You’ll join a small, multidisciplinary team building products that create value for our users and business. Working closely with product, design and engineering colleagues, you’ll turn agreed opportunities into working products and validate them with users.


AI will be a core part of how you build and deliver from development through testing and validation. You’ll help improve these ways of working and share what works with the wider organisation.


You’ll bring hands-on experience across frontend and backend development, with deeper expertise in one or both. You’ll build the services and experiences needed to deliver complete products, contributing beyond your main specialism and taking responsibility for how the software performs in production.


The team starts with a lab approach: focused scope, short feedback loops, and room to experiment. As we learn what works, the aim is to evolve into an established structure with ongoing product responsibilities. You’ll help shape that journey and take care of the products as they develop.


**What your day might look like:**


* Turn agreed product scope into working products and testable releases
* Design, build, and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations
* Build frontend experiences that connect those services to users
* Apply and improve advanced AI-assisted workflows across development, testing, and validation
* Integrate AI capabilities where they add value to the product
* Work with product and design to use data, user insights, and hypotheses to guide implementation and validate outcomes
* Improve performance, reliability, and maintainability as products develop
* Contribute to deployment, maintenance, and operation, taking responsibility for the software you deliver

### **What we’re looking for**


You’ve used AI across substantial parts of product delivery, beyond individual coding suggestions. You can explain your contribution, how you verified the result, and what you learned.


**For this role, we’re looking for:**


* **Technical depth:** Strong engineering expertise in frontend or backend development, or both. You can make architecture trade-offs and deliver reliable software using automated testing, debugging, and production monitoring
* **Practical width:** Hands-on experience across frontend development with React or a comparable framework and backend development with Node.js and JavaScript/TypeScript, including APIs, integrations and data handling, enabling you to deliver complete products across the stack
* **AI-native delivery:** Experience using advanced workflows, such as agent-based or spec-driven development. You can structure work for AI, provide context, evaluate the resulting software, and take responsibility for what reaches production
* **Product experience:** Work in a product organisation and a cross-functional product team with product managers and designers. You use data and user insights to test hypotheses, validate value, and take shared responsibility for outcomes after release

**It’s a bonus if you have:**


* Experience building backend services or systems in Rust and/or Python
* Experience with AWS and distributed, event-driven or serverless systems
* Experience with automated delivery pipelines and infrastructure as code
* Experience with mobile development or other technologies that broaden your contribution
* Experience with experimentation tooling and optimising toward user experience metrics
* Experience with integration of AI/ML products and incorporating user feedback signals as feedback

You bring approaches we can learn from and can demonstrate where AI has improved your delivery, as well as where it has required more care. You are comfortable challenging existing practices and helping the team test better ones.


We value curiosity, ownership and colleagues who are generous with their knowledge and help others succeed.


### **What's in it for you**


An opportunity to help shape how Viaplay builds products with AI. You’ll work closely with colleagues across disciplines, contribute across the stack, and see how your work influences both the products we deliver and the way the team develops.


You’ll join at a stage where there is room to experiment and help establish practices that can benefit the wider organisation.


### **What we offer you**


* **We’ve got you covered!** 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* **Your wellbeing matters.** We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* **Flexibility that works.** We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
* **A safe space to grow and up-skill.** Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
* **An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year.** This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
* **Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do.** So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

### **Hit play today**


If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
  

  

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Data Ingestion Engineer to Handelsbanken
description:
Would you like to help shape the bank’s data capabilities and take on a central role with significant influence? We are looking for someone who wants to develop and optimize our data platform in close collaboration with dedicated colleagues.
   

  

**Your team** 
 You will be part of a cross-functional team consisting of developers, an Agile Product Owner, and a Team Coach. Together, we work to deliver functionality that strengthens Handelsbanken’s data capabilities.
   

  

 In addition to working within the team, you will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and business stakeholders. We enjoy working together, and our team is characterized by a high level of expertise, strong commitment, and broad experience across both technology and business.
   

  

**Your role**
 As a Data Ingestion Engineer, you will work with our data platform, further developing solutions, building integrations with other data sources, and driving process automation. Together with the team, you will develop and support the data platform, with a focus on data migration and reconciliation (data quality). You will also contribute to building different ingestion patterns for the function. The role also includes platform management, troubleshooting, and onboarding various teams to the data platform, as well as collaborating with the business and other stakeholders.
   

  

 Together with the team, you will contribute to sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues. The role gives you the opportunity to influence how the bank works with data, build solutions that make a difference, and further develop your technical skills in other data areas such as Data Governance and Data Analytics.
   

  

**Your profile**
 We are looking for someone with experience in data integration and data migration within modern data platforms. You are accustomed to working with data migration, integrations, and data pipelines in cloud-based environments, and you have an interest in data quality and efficient data flows. You understand Swedish and are willing to improve your skills, or you already speak Swedish fluently.
   

  

 We are looking for someone with:
   

  

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, alternatively AWS or GCP.
* Experience in verifying data quality and data flows.
* Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF).
* Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC) solutions.
* Good knowledge of CI/CD, ELT/ETL, MS SQL, Linux, and Python.
* Experience with DevOps methodologies.
* Experience with shell scripting (e.g. Bash) and C# is considered an advantage.


 As a person, you enjoy working in a team, are happy to share your knowledge, and support colleagues in achieving common goals. You organize, document, and plan your work effectively so that both you and others can follow it. At the same time, you are solution-oriented and curious, finding creative ways to solve problems and understanding how different components fit together.
   

  

**We look forward to receiving your application**

*the final candidate is also required to undergo and successfully pass a background check conducted by an external provider before employment can be offered.*
